Mas mbala̱n jwe ni ka̱li wu dla̱m hwa ga̱ɓa tenti. Yek ɓanti cisi ten ga̱ɓa gwe ta̱ dla̱m wu. Yek sa̱ wuli ɗe, “Ɗa̱ nii ka̱n a pi nu gwi? Ko yen ga̱n go tik ɗe yen ga̱ Yusupu wu so?”

Yek Yesu wulsi ɗe, “A yisi ɗe ka dla̱m ga̱ɓa tena̱n nu ɗe, ‘Ma̱n ba̱lti ika̱n, ndok gaa gwa la.’ Ilgwe ka̱ lam dla̱mti go yek ɗe, ‘Yek laki ɗe ba̱ka̱ pa̱l wul cit ɓanti ka ba̱n gwa na̱k gwe ka̱ pa̱li a Kaparnahum so ye?’”
Yek Yesu po hwisi ɗe, “Gem ka̱n, ma̱n dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya a mbi nalti ka̱ ba̱n gwas so.

Gem, guli modli ni ɗa̱ wonti ka̱ atl ga̱ Israila ka̱ gin gwe Iliya ma̱n dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya ni ka̱ atli wu. Gin ɗe mekan na̱ tatlti tlo, ɗe ba̱ ze nda sowu, yek kuza̱n tlo mbala̱n mas ka̱ atl ga̱ Israila.
Ama ba̱ Nya shin Iliya mal modli ju so. Yek ta̱ shinti mal guli kili gon a Zarepat ma̱n da̱nti ka̱ atl ga̱ Sidon.

Sogo ɓo daama̱nki ten Ilisha ma̱n dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya ma̱lgwe laki yek Naaman ndoki ɗa̱ka̱ cwo gita ka̱wu, a Naaman wo ma̱n Siriya ka̱n, a ma̱n cwo gita ni ɗa wonti ka̱ Israila jwe na̱ma lamti ndokti wu.”
Yek sa̱ kumi nu wugo, yek mbadl lili ma̱jwe ni ka̱lu motgaami wu.
Yek sa̱ tlinya na̱ apti, yek sa̱ tol Yesu ten za̱nda̱l ba̱mi. Sa̱ na̱ma lamti ta̱s jekti sut ten za̱nda̱li.
Yek Yesu yil ɗa̱ka̱ tlo gwasa̱n ka yek ta̱ zigaa.
Yek Yesu li Kaparnahum ba̱n gon ka̱ atl ga̱ Galili, yek ta̱ nisi ma ga̱ɓa ka̱lu motgaa gwasa̱n gas shukti.
Ka̱ lwisi mago ɓanti ci mbala̱n ten ilgwe ta̱ dla̱m wu na̱k ɗe mas ga̱ɓa gwas wo kiɗi ga̱ɓa ka̱wu.
A Yesu ni ka̱lu motgaa, yek ma̱n byas ma̱zhe gon njel tlilti yal nya ɗe,
“Tli ɗa̱ mal ni ka̱! Yek mo ni sukki ye, Yesu ga̱ ma̱n Nazarat? Ka̱ sa tlot ga̱na̱n kaa? A yisi, ki wo ma̱n cilti ka̱n gwe Nya shinti sut ɗu.”

Yek Yesu dla̱lla̱t ka, yek ta̱ wulti ɗe, “Da̱m mbetlak!” Yek ta̱ po wul ma̱zhesi ɗe, “Yil ɗa̱ka̱ ti ka.” Yek ma̱zhesi jek ma̱li a atli ka̱ tlo mbala̱n yek ta̱ yil ɗa̱ka̱ ma̱li ka kangwe ba̱ta̱ kumit cwo sowu.
Yek ɓanti ci mbala̱n yek sa̱ wuli ɗe, “Nda̱lti yek ni ga̱ɓa ga̱ ma̱lga̱n ɗa̱ nu ye, ɗe mas na̱ ma̱zhe mago asa̱ kum ga̱ɓa gwas wu?”
Yek ga̱ɓa ten ilgwe ta̱ pa̱li wu ma̱tl ɗa̱nka̱ ba̱mi ka.
Yek Yesu yil ɗa̱ka̱ lu motgaa ga̱ gwasa̱n ka, yek ta̱ li lubii ɗa̱ Siman.
Yek Yesu ngus malti yek ta̱ matl cwoɓi, yek cwoɓi zakti yek ta̱ tlinya ninge-ninge yek ta̱ njelisi pa̱lti wul.
Cin ɓal njaa ta̱ nda bii go yek wonti mbala̱n ma̱n cwo tul malti yek ta̱ ngusi za̱t ang gwas tensi asa̱ na̱ma ndokti,
ma̱zhe mago sa̱ yil ɗa̱ka̱ mbala̱n ka wonti asa̱ na̱ma lakti yal asa̱ na̱ma wulti ɗe, “Kik ɗe Yen ga̱ Nya.” Yek ta̱ matlsi yek ba̱ta̱ zaksi ta̱s ga̱ɓa so na̱k ɗe sa̱ yisi ɗe tik ɗe Almasihu wu.
Lu tlo wugo, yek Yesu li ka̱lu gon na̱ ngusi, a mbala̱mi na̱ma ta ngot gwasi yek sa̱ mbit wugo yek sa̱ wulti ɗe ba̱s zigaa ata̱ zaksi so.
Ama yek ta̱ wule, “Ngetli ka̱n nii ɗe ta dla̱m ga̱ɓa ma̱n ta̱mti ten kangwe mbala̱n a kan Nya ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl gwasa̱n wu, na̱k ɗe yek laki yek sa̱ shina̱n sut ɗu.”
Yek ta̱ ngusi dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ka̱lu motgaa ji Ma̱n Yehuda a Yehudiya.
Gas gon, Yesu na̱ma dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya ten bi bal ze gon asa̱ mbe ɗe Jeneselet. Yek mbala̱n wonti da̱n njaa malti ta̱s kumti.
Yek ta̱ yen jirgi ze jon ɗe lop jwe ba̱ ma̱lgon ni giɓi sowu ten bi bal zesi, ji ma̱n dopti kwesi, sa̱ wut ka̱li, asa̱ na̱ma polti wul dopti kwes gwasa̱n.
Yek ta̱ te ka̱ jirgi zesi ga̱ Siman Biturus wu. Yek ta̱ ngem Siman Biturus ta̱s nak jek jirgi te ka̱ zesi ka̱. Yek ta̱ da̱m ka̱ jirgi zesi yek ta̱ nde hwit ga̱ɓa mbala̱n.
Ta̱ pak ga̱ɓe wugo, yek ta̱ wul Siman Biturus ɗe, “Nii go li ka̱lu gwe dlunti mani wu, aka̱ lak wul dopti kwes gwa ka̱ zesi, ka doɓi wonti.”
Yek Siman Biturus wule, “Ma̱n lishti, ma̱ mul ten dipti ze a ba̱ma̱ dop ilgon so, ama na̱k ɗe ka̱ dla̱m nugo ma po lak wul dopti kwesi ka̱ zesi ɗa.”
Sa̱ lak wul dopti kwesi wugo, yek njika̱n ka na̱ kwesi hal ɓa nda keshti.
Yek sa̱ mbe yilkeni jwasa̱n jwe ni te ka̱ zopsi jirgi gon ka̱wu ta̱s lak zisi ang. Yek sa̱ li teɗi yek sa̱ zisi ang, yek jirgi pak lop njika̱n ka na̱ kwesi na̱k wule a su ga̱s gaa ze.
Siman Biturus yen ilgwe na̱ma pa̱t wu wugo, yek ta̱ ngus na̱ gaa hwula̱n a cina ɗa̱ Yesu ka, yek ta̱ wule, “Bagaa, a na̱ma ngemti gwa ta̱k zaka̱nni, ma̱n pa̱lti byas wul ka̱ɗe ami.”
Na̱ Siman Biturus na̱ ma̱jwe ni sukti wu yen kangwe sa̱ dop kwesi wugo yek ili ngusisi cit ɓanti.

Yela̱n dopti kwes jwasi, ka̱ Yakubu suk Yohana mil ji Zabadi mago ili cisi ɓanti pak. Yek Yesu wul Siman Biturus ɗe, “Ba̱ ɓanti cik so, ndok ase, mbala̱n ka̱n ka ngusi dopti gwasa̱n kwes ka po ni so.”
Sa̱ na̱ma yilti tot ten bi cikɗi, yek sa̱ zak mas wul jwasa̱n yek sa̱ kop Yesu.

Yesu ni ka̱ ba̱n gon nu go, yek ta̱ mo suk ma̱n bal cwo gita gon, yek ma̱li yen Yesu wugo, yek ta̱ ngus a cina ɗatka yek ta̱ ngusa̱l gaa gwas atli. Yek ta̱ ngem Yesu ɗe, “Bagaa, kume ka̱ lami go aka̱ ndoka̱nni.”
Yek Yesu tak ang, yek ta̱ ta̱n ma̱li, yek ta̱ wulti ɗe, “A lami wi, ndoki,” na̱ dla̱mti nu, yek ma̱li ndoki.
Yek Yesu wulti ɗe, “Ba̱k hwi ma̱lgon so, ama li mal ma̱n Pa̱ris ta̱s yenki aka̱ ba̱lti ilgwe ta taki Nya wu, na̱k gwe ni ka̱ mba̱t ga̱ Musa wu. Na̱ nu ka̱n mas mbala̱n a yisi ɗe ka̱ ndoki wi.”
Mas na̱ ndwal ga̱ɓa gwe Yesu ba̱l ma̱li wu, yek ga̱ɓa tenti ngusi ma̱tlti ka̱ mbala̱n. Yek mbala̱n wonti ngusi la̱t tet malti ta̱s kumti, si mago ta̱s ndokti ɗa̱ka̱ cwo gwasa̱n ka.
A Yesu kul yil ɗa̱ka̱ mbala̱n ka, ata̱ la ngem Nya ka̱ me.

Gas gon Yesu nima hwit ga̱ɓa mbala̱n ka̱ ba̱n gon, a ma̱n Paresi suk ma̱n yisti mba̱t ga̱ Musa jwe yil tet ka̱ atl ga̱ Galili suk Yehudiya suk tet ka̱ bal ba̱n Wurshelima wu ni na̱ zhila njaa ka̱li. A nda̱lti gwe Nya ba̱l Yesu ta̱s ndok mbala̱n wu ni tenti.
Yek ma̱jon kan ma̱lgon ɗe asa̱n tlet ka̱wu ten lumulti, sa̱ na̱ma tlot gwasa̱n ta̱s telti gibboo ta̱s lakti atli a cina ɗa̱ Yesu ka.

Yek ba̱sa̱ mbi tantu so na̱k ɗe mbala̱n wonti hwo wu. Sa̱ yeni nu wugo, yek sa̱ tolti ten gaa bii yek sa̱ ɓul gaa biimi yek sa̱ yilla̱t suɗi ten lumulti gwasi, yek sa̱ mulla̱t atli ka̱ tlo ga̱ mbala̱n a cina ɗa̱ Yesu ka.
Yek Yesu yen za̱t mbadl ten Nya gwasa̱n wugo, yek ta̱ wul ma̱n cwoɓi ɗe, “Sa̱ taas byas wul jwa ka̱wi.”
Yek ma̱n Paresi suk ma̱n yisti mba̱t ga̱ Musa ngusi nala̱nti ɗe, “Wok ɗe ga̱n ɗe paa ta̱ dla̱m ga̱ɓa mbulti ga̱ Nya nu wo? Nya na̱ ngus ka̱ɗe ma̱n manti taasti byas wul ga̱ mbala̱n ka.”
Na̱k ɗe Yesu yis ilgwe sa̱ na̱ma daamti gwasa̱n dani wu, yek ta̱ wulsi ɗe, “Yek laki ɗe ka̱ na̱ma daamti gwaka̱n nu ye?
Gwik bom so mani gwi, na̱ ta̱ mbala̱n wule, ‘Sa̱ taas byas wul jwa ka̱wi,’ sogo ta̱s wule ‘Tlinya ta̱k zigaa?’
Ama ta̱k yisi ɗe ami Yen ga̱ Mbala̱n man taasti byas wul ji mbala̱n ka ten dii atli.” Yek ta̱ wul ma̱lgwe asa̱mi tlet ka̱wi ɗe, “Tlinya ta̱k kan lumulti gwa ta̱k li gee.”
Ninge yek ma̱li tlinya ten gwel ga̱ mbala̱n wonti yek ta̱ tlil lumulti gwasi yek ta̱ pal ga̱zi ata̱ na̱ma ta̱sti ga̱ Nya.
Mas jwasa̱n yek sa̱ ngip bi ka̱ ang ɗe ɓanti ɓa cisi wu. Yek sa̱ ngusi ta̱sti ga̱ Nya asa̱ na̱ma wulti ɗe, “Ase ka̱n ma̱ yen wul cit ɓanti.”

Kaal ɗa̱ nu, yek Yesu yil ɗa̱ka̱ ba̱n gwe ta̱ nima hwit ga̱ɓa mbala̱n wu ka, yek ta̱ yen ma̱n kanti wulpi boo gon asa̱ mbet ɗe Lawi. Ata̱ ni na̱ zhila ka̱lu kanti wulpi boomi. Yek Yesu wulti ɗe, “Li te ta̱k koɓa̱nni.”
Yek ta̱ zak kanti wulpi boomi yek ta̱ kop Yesu.
Yek Lawi mbe motgaa hwol tuki a lubii ɗatka ta̱ mbala̱n yen nalti ga̱ Yesu. Ma̱n kanti wulpi boo wonti suk ma̱jon asa̱ na̱ma ngukti wul suksi.

Yek ma̱n Paresi suk ma̱n yisti mba̱t ga̱ Musa jon nda nala̱nti asa̱ na̱ma wulti ga̱ ma̱n kopti ji Yesu ɗe, “Yek laki ɗe ka̱a̱ na̱ma ngukti aka̱a̱ na̱ma tlati suk ma̱n kanti wulpi boo suk ma̱n pa̱lti byas wul ye?”
Yek Yesu wulsi ɗe, “Ma̱jwe ba̱ cwo na̱ma cit gwasa̱n sogo, sa ngo ma̱n ika̱n so, se ma̱n cwo.
A tul ɗe ta mbe ma̱n pa̱lti zok wul so, ama ma̱n pa̱lti byas wul ta̱s ci atl gaa mal Nya.”

Yek ma̱jon wul Yesu ɗe, “Ma̱n kopti ji Yohana wo asa̱ pa̱l ka̱lka̱ze ngemti Nya nja-nja, mil lishti ji ma̱n Paresi mago nu. Ama ma̱n kopti jwa wo ba̱sa pa̱li nu so na̱k ɗe asa̱ nguk wul asa̱ tla ze mas cin wu.”
Yek Yesu ballisi ɗe, “Ka̱ yeni go yela̱n ji pyal kos a pa̱l ka̱lka̱ze ngemti Nya a pyal kos yi suksi a?
Ama gas gwe sa̱ kan pyal kos ka̱wu ka̱n sa̱ pa̱l ka̱lka̱ze ngemti Nya.”
Yek Yesu mwesi ga̱ɓa gon ɗe, “Mbala̱n a kesh pyal luka̱l ata̱ dla̱m ten gusi so. Kume ta̱ pa̱li nugo, ta kesh pyal luka̱l gwas ka. A ba̱ pyalisi a mbun ten gusi so.
A ba̱ mbala̱n a shot pyal ze inabi ka̱ gus zwi kuul so ɗe kume ta̱ pa̱li nugo, gus zwi kuli a mbutl ka, a ze inabisi a shot ka, a zwi kuli mago a lilka.
Pyal ze inabi wo ka̱ pyal zwi kuul ka̱n asa̱ shoti.
A ba̱ mbala̱n a lam tlat pyal ze inabi kaal ɗa̱ ta̱ tla gusi wi so, ta wule, gusi wu ta̱m man pyali wu.”
Gas shukti ga̱ Ma̱n Yehuda gon yek Yesu suk ma̱n kopti jwas koɓi tuka̱ zhin alkama gon yek sa̱ ngusi celti gaa alkame asa̱ na̱ma wumti asa̱ na̱ma ngukti.
Yek ma̱n Paresi jon wulsi ɗe, “Yek laki ɗe ka̱ na̱ma pa̱lti ilgwe ba̱ mbun ɗe ta̱ mbala̱n pa̱li gas shukti wu na̱k gwe ni ga̱ lishi ka̱ mba̱t ga̱ Musa so gwe?”
Yek Yesu ballisi ɗe, “Ka̱ yisa̱n ilgwe Dauda pa̱li ɗe kuza̱n na̱ma tlot gwasi suk yela̱n jwas wu sa?

Kangwe ɗe ta̱ te ka̱ bii ga̱ Nya yek ta̱ kan burodi gwe sa̱ zi ka̱ biimi wu, yek ta̱ nguki hal yek ta̱ ba̱l naami ma̱n kopti jwasi, gwe mbun ɗe ta̱ mbala̱n mas nguk sowu, se ma̱n da̱nti ka̱ biimi. Nu ka̱n mba̱t ga̱ Musa dla̱m pak.”
Yek Yesu po dla̱misi ɗa̱ɗe, “Ami Yen ga̱ Mbala̱n wo, amik ɗe bagaa ga̱ gas shukti.”
Gas shukti ga̱ Ma̱n Yehuda gon ɗa, yek Yesu te ka̱lu motgaa ga̱ gwasa̱n ata̱ nisi ma ga̱ɓa, a ma̱lgon ni ka̱li ɗe ang shinti gwas tla ka̱wu.
Yek ma̱n yisti mba̱t ga̱ Musa suk ma̱n Paresi wuti gwel Yesu ta̱s ɓo yeni, ko ta ɗakca̱n mba̱t ga̱ Musa ata̱ ndokti mbala̱n gas shukti, ta̱s mbi byas ilgon tenti.
A Yesu yis ilgwe sa̱ na̱ma daamti gwasa̱n dani wu. Yek ta̱ wul ma̱li ɗe, “Tlinya ta̱k dla̱l a nde,” yek ma̱li tlinya yek ta̱ dla̱l a cina ɗaasika.
Yek Yesu wulsi ɗe, “A na̱ma ngemti gwaka̱n, cin pa̱lti byas wul ka̱ɗe ga̱n ma, ko ga̱ pa̱lti hwa wul, ta̱ yilli mbadl kaa ko ta̱ tlo mbadli?”
Yek ta̱ ngusi yenti gwasa̱n na̱m-na̱m, yek ta̱ wul ma̱li ɗe, “Tak ang gwa,” yek ta̱ tak ami go ndoki wi.
Ten nu ka̱n yek mbadl lili ma̱n yisti mba̱t ga̱ Musa suk ma̱n Paresi i'e. Yek sa̱ nda ga̱ɓa ten ilgwe sa pa̱lit wu.
Ka̱ multi jwisi, yek Yesu to ten tla̱da̱l, ta̱s ngem Nya, yek ta̱ mul ten ngemti Nya.
Yek lu tlo wugo, yek ta̱ mbe ma̱n kopti jwasi mas jwasa̱n. Yek ta̱ botl ɗe kutl cet lop ka̱si, yek ta̱ mbesi ɗe mil shinti ji botli.
Ka̱ Siman gwe Yesu zit shin ɗe Biturus wu, suk yilka gwasi Andarawus, suk Yakubu suk Yohana suk Pilip suk Bartilomi
suk Matta suk Tomas suk Yakubu yen ga̱ Halpa suk Siman gwe asa̱ mbet ɗe ma̱n lamti ji mbala̱n ga̱ atl gwas wu.
Suk Yehuda yen ga̱ Yakubu suk Yehuda Iskariyoti ma̱lgwe ba̱l bi ga̱ Yesu ta̱s tlot wu.

Yek Yesu yil sut ka̱ tla̱da̱l suk ma̱n kopti jwasi. Yek ta dla̱l ten bal dii atl gon suk mbala̱n wonti suk ma̱n kopti jwasi. Ka̱ lwisi mago a wonti mbala̱n tet ɗa̱nka̱ atl ga̱ Yehudiya suk Wurshelima suk tet ka̱ atl ga̱ Taya suk Sidon jwe ni ten bi bal ze wu ni ɗa.
Sa̱ li tet ɗe ta̱s kumti asa̱ mbi ndokti ɗa̱ka̱ cwo gwasa̱n ka, ma̱jwe duu ma̱zhe dopsi mago yek sa̱ ndoki pak.
Yek mas mbala̱n dlosi ɗe ta̱s ta̱nti na̱ ang na̱k ɗe nda̱lti na̱ma yilti tet tenti wu. Yek mas jwasa̱n sa̱ ndoki.
Yek Yesu yen ma̱n kopti jwasi, yek ta̱ wulsi ɗe, “Kii wo ma̱n mbit hwa wul ga̱ Nya ka̱n kii ɗe ba̱ ilgon ni kii ɗa̱ sowu. Na̱ nu ka̱n Nya a da̱n ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl gwaka̱n.

Kii wo ma̱n mbit hwa wul ga̱ Nya ka̱n kii ɗe kuza̱n na̱ma tlot gwaka̱n ninge wu, na̱ nu ka̱n gas gon wo a kumkii. Kii wo ma̱n mbit hwa wul ga̱ Nya ka̱n kii ɗe ka̱ na̱ma kulu ninge wu, na̱ nu ka̱n gasi gon wo ka gitli.

Kii wo ma̱n mbit hwa wul ga̱ Nya ka̱n kii ɗe mbala̱n na̱ma nget gwaka̱n, yek sa̱ yilla̱kii ɗa̱ka̱ dlo gwasa̱n ka, asa̱ na̱ma byalti gwaka̱n, asa̱ na̱ma wulti gwaka̱n ɗe, ‘Kii wo ma̱n byas mbadl ka̱n,’ na̱k ɗe ma̱n kopti ga̱ Yen ga̱ Mbala̱n ka̱ɗe kii wu.
Pa̱la̱n hwol tuki aka̱ lak icin! Bal ɓatlti na̱ma ɓa̱tti gwaka̱n to nya ka. Daama̱n kangwe kolsi jwasa̱n pa̱li ma̱n dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya tek wu.
Ka da̱n ɗe wul cit gonti kii ɗe wul ni kii ɗa̱ wu, ninge ka̱ɗe hwol tuk gwaka̱n.

Ka da̱n ɗe wul cit gonti kii ɗe kuza̱n na̱ma tlot gwaka̱n so ni wu, na̱ nu ka̱n kuza̱n a ya tlokii gas gon. Ka da̱n ɗe wul cit gonti kii ɗe ka̱ na̱ma gitlti ni wu, na̱ nu ka̱n ka ya lak pa̱l duu tuki aka̱ na̱ma kulu.
Ka da̱n ɗe wul cit gonti kii ɗe mbala̱n na̱ma ta̱sti gwaka̱n wu. Nu ka̱n kolsi jwasa̱n ta̱s ma̱n shelti lal yisti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya pak.
“A ni kii ma hwiti, kii ɗe ka̱ na̱ma kumti gi wu, lama̱n ma̱n nget gwaka̱n. A ka̱ pa̱lisi hwa wul.
Pa̱li hwa wul ma̱n byalti jwaka̱n, aka̱a̱ ngemi Nya ma̱jwe pa̱likii ngalci wu.
Kume ma̱lgon ɓek kalka̱ng ten ka̱t ang shinti wu, ballit ka̱t ang yali pak. A kume ma̱lgon lam wul yitlat gwa wu, ba̱lti luka̱l gwa pak.
Mas ma̱lgwe ngemik wul go aka̱ ba̱lti. A ma̱lgwe kamit wul ka ngetli go ba̱k wule ta̱s pallik so.
Pa̱li hwa wul mbala̱n na̱k gwe ka̱ lami ɗe ta̱s pa̱likii wu.
Ɗe kume ma̱jwe lamkii wu ka̱n ka̱a̱ lamsi na̱ ngusa̱n go, ɗa̱ nii ka̱n ka mbi hwa wul gwi? Ma̱n pa̱lti byas wul mago sa̱ lam ma̱n lamti jwasa̱n.
A kume ma̱jwe pa̱likii hwa wul ka̱n, aka̱a̱ pa̱lisi na̱ ngusa̱n go, yek hul dlo gwaka̱n suk ma̱n pa̱lti byas wul ye? Ma̱n pa̱lti byas wul mago asa̱ pa̱li nu.
Ɗe kume ma̱jwe asa̱ ɓatlkii wu ka̱n ka ba̱lsi duul go, ɗa̱ nii ka̱n ka̱ mbi hwa wul gwi? Ma̱n pa̱lti byas wul mago asa̱ pa̱li yilkeni nu ta̱s ɓatlsi ɗa.

Ama, kii wo lama̱n ma̱n nget gwaka̱n, aka̱a̱ pa̱lisi hwa wul. Ba̱lini a ba̱k za̱n mbadl palla̱ti so. Apaa ka̱a̱ mbi bal ɓatlti aka̱a̱ da̱n ɗe mil ji Nya Bal Kakshe. A ta̱ pa̱li hwa wul ma̱jwe ba̱sa pa̱l hwol tuk sowu suk ma̱n ngalci.
Da̱ma̱n ɗe ma̱n yenti gonti ji mbala̱n na̱k kangwe Aba gwaka̱n ni ɗe ma̱n yenti gonti wu.
“Ba̱k zi byas wul ma̱lgon so, kii mago sa zikii so pak. Ba̱k pa̱li byas da̱mti ma̱lgon so, kii mago ma̱lgon a pa̱likii so. Taasa̱n byas wul ji mbala̱n ɗa̱ ten mbadl ka, kii mago sa taas gwaka̱n ka.
Ba̱lini, kii mago sa ba̱lkii. Gal ga̱ njikmi i'e, hal a ngusi shoti, hal a shoti ki naami ka̱ ang luka̱l, gal gwe ka̱a̱ cinga̱li na̱ nali go, kii mago na̱ nali ka̱n a cinga̱likii.”
Yek Yesu hwisi ga̱ɓa gon ɗe, “Ɗa̱ nii ka̱n dwa a nde dwa cina gwi? Kume pi nugo, mas jwasa̱n sa nda ka̱ shu.
Yen lishti a nal man ma̱n lishti gwas so. Ama yen ma̱n lishti gwe pak lishti gwas wugo ta̱ da̱m na̱k ma̱n lishti gwasi.
Ka̱ man yenti yen coklan ka̱ gwel ga̱ yilka gwa ama ba̱ka̱ man yenti guda̱l yencin gwe ni ka̱ gwel gwa wu so

Ɗa̱ nii ka̱n kama̱n wulti ga̱ yilka gwa ɗe, ‘Yilka gini, ha̱nta yillik yen coklan ga̱ ka̱ gwel wu ka,’ a yekgu go ba̱ka̱ man yenti ga̱ bal guda̱l yencin gwe ni ka̱ gweli gwa wu sowu? ki ma̱n pa̱lti riya, nda ndusti guda̱l yencin gwe nikka̱ gwel wu ka, kangwe ka man yenti lu i'e aka̱ ndusi nak coklan gwe ni ka̱ gwel ga̱ yilka gwa wu ka.
“Hwa tlindi wuta̱n byas yandi so aba̱ byas tlindi wut hwa yandi so.
Tlindi wo ten yandi gwas ka̱n a mbala̱n yisi. Ka kotl tula̱n tet ten tlindi iil so, sogo yandi inabi tet ten tlindi tula̱n so.
A hwa mbala̱n pa̱l hwa wul na̱k ɗe hwa wul ka nik ka mbadli wu, a byas mbala̱n wo byas wul ka̱n ata̱ pa̱li, na̱k ɗe byas wul ka̱ nit ka̱ mbadli wu. Ilgwe ni ka̱ mbadl go, yek ka̱n a bi dla̱mi.
“Yek laki aka̱ mbe ɗe Bagaa ye? Ɗe ka̱ nge pa̱lti ilgwe a hwiki ɗe ta̱k pa̱li wu?
Ma̱lgwe li tet mala̱nni yek ta̱ kati ka̱n yek ta̱ pa̱l ilgwe a hwit ɗe ta̱s pa̱li go, ba hwiki wunda̱l ga̱ ma̱li.

Ta̱ ni na̱k ma̱lgwe ɗe ta̱ ɓa kin bii gwas go, yek ta̱ ɗuk atl dlunti, yek ta̱ lak zhila kinti biimi ten pa, yek dla̱lka njika̱n wugo, yek ze tak ɓo biimi, ama ba̱ nda so. Na̱k ɗe zhila biimi wo ten pa ka̱n ni wu.

Mas ma̱lgwe kum ga̱ɓa gini a ba̱ta̱ pa̱l ilgwe a hwit ɗe ta̱s pa̱li wu sogo, na̱k ma̱lgwe ta̱ kin bii gwas ɗe ba̱ta̱ nda zhila biimi hwaɓi sowu ka̱n ta̱ ni, yek dla̱lka njika̱n wugo, yek ze ɓo biimi wugo yek pa̱l byas ndati.”
Yesu paki dla̱mti mas ga̱ɓe jwisi mbala̱n wugo, yek ta̱ li ka̱ ba̱n Kaparnahum.
Yek zhel ga̱ bal ma̱n hapti tlo ga̱ ma̱n Roma gon ka̱wu na̱ cwo na̱k wule ta ma̱shinni, a ma̱n hapti dlomi lam zheli i'e.
Ma̱n hapti dlomi kum bi ga̱ Yesu wugo, yek ta̱ shin kiɗi Ma̱n Yehuda jon ta̱s ngem Yesu ta̱s lak ndok zhel gwasi.
Sa̱ li mal Yesu wugo, yek sa̱ ngemti i'e, yek sa̱ wulti ɗe, “Mbun ɗe ta̱k ndok zhel ga̱ ma̱lga̱n,
na̱k ɗe ta̱ lam mbala̱n jina̱n hal ta̱ kinini lu motgaa wu.”
Yek Yesu li suksi. Ta̱ ɓal njaa ta̱s mbuki lubiimi go, yek bal ma̱n hapti dlomi shin yela̱n jwasi ta̱s hwi Yesu ɗe, “Ki wo ma̱n nalti ka̱n, ba̱k nol gaa gwa so, a mbuki ta̱k li tet lubii ɗaaka so.
Yek laki yek baa mbuki ɗe ta li tet malki so. Ga̱ɓa ka̱li, zhel gi a ndoki.

Ami mago a ang ɗa̱ ma̱lgwe nii cina wu ka̱n a ni, a ma̱n hapti tlo jon nii atl ɗaaka pak, aa kul wul ga̱n ɗe, ‘Li ka̱lu gee,’ ata̱ li; aa po wul ga̱n ɗe, ‘Li te,’ ata̱ li te. A kume a wul zhel gi ɗe, ‘Pa̱li na̱k ga̱n wu,’ ata̱ pa̱li.”

Yesu kumi nu wugo yek ta̱ ngip bi ka̱ ang, ɗe ta̱ yen za̱t mbadl ten Nya ga̱ ma̱li wu, yek ta̱ balla̱t mal mbala̱n jwe na̱ma kopti gwas wu, yek ta̱ wulsi ɗe, “A ni kii ma hwiti, ka̱ ma̱n Yisiraila mago, a yen ma̱n za̱t mbadl ten Nya na̱ nda̱lti na̱k ga̱ ma̱lga̱n so.”
Ma̱jwe ma̱n hapti dlomi shinsi wu pal tek wugo yek sa̱ mbi go zhel ga̱ ma̱li ndoki wi.
Ɓo la̱m da̱nti so, yek Yesu lika̱ nak'en ba̱n gon asa̱ mbe ɗe Nayin a ma̱n kopti jwas suk mbala̱n wonti na̱ma kopti gwasi.
Sa̱ ɓal njaa ta̱s te ka̱ bi dlaboo ba̱mi go, yek ma̱jon ka̱wu na̱ hwuu ga̱ yen gon, a tik ɗe yen ga̱ kili gwe kos ma̱shit ka̱wu na̱ ngusi, a mbala̱n wonti na̱ma kopti gwasa̱n.
Yek Yesu yen kilisi wugo, yek gonti gwas citi, yek ta̱ wulti ɗe, “Po kul so.”
Yek Yesu lak ta̱n wul kanti hwuunisi na̱ ang yek ma̱jwe kan hwuunisi wu dla̱li, yek ta̱ wule, “Yen mbala̱n, tlinya!”
Yek yeni tlinya yek ta̱ njel ga̱ɓa. Yek Yesu ba̱ltiti ana gwasi.
Yek ɓanti ci mbala̱n mas jwasa̱n, yek sa̱ ba̱l nalti Nya asa̱ na̱ma wulti ɗe, “Bal ma̱n dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya tulini wi. Nya su suɗi ta̱s kis mbala̱n jwas wi.”
Yek ga̱ɓa ten ilgwe Yesu pa̱li wu ma̱tl ɗa̱nka̱ Yehudiya ka suk ba̱n jwe ni njaa wu.
Ma̱n kopti ji Yohana ma̱n baptisma hwi Yohana mas wul jwe Yesu na̱ma pa̱lti wu wugo, yek ta̱ mbe ɗe lop ka̱si.
Yek ta̱ shinsi mal Yesu ta̱s kum ga̱zi ɗe, “Kik ɗe ma̱lgwe a tul gwa? Ko ta̱n ɓa̱tti ta̱ yi suɗi?”
Sa̱ li mal Yesu wugo yek sa̱ wulti ɗe, “Yohana ma̱n baptisma shinnii malki ta̱n kum ga̱zi ɗe, ko kik ɗe ma̱lgwe a tul wu? Ko ta̱n ɓa̱tti ta̱ yi suɗi?”
Sa̱ ni ka̱li nugo, yek Yesu ndok mbala̱n wonti ɗa̱ka̱ cwo jwasa̱n ka, yek ta̱ yilli ma̱zhe ɗa̱ka̱ mbala̱n ka, yek ta̱ ɓuli gwel dwa wonti.

Yek Yesu hwi mil shinti ɗe, “Lak hwi Yohana wul jwe ka̱a̱ kumi yek ka̱a̱ yeni wu, gwel ji dwa ɓuli, ma̱jwe man la̱t na̱ asa̱n sowu li na̱ asa̱n, ma̱n cwo gita ndoki, a ma̱jwe kum ka̱n sowu kum ka̱n, a ma̱jwe ma̱sh ju tli ɗa̱ka̱ ma̱shka̱n ka, ma̱jwe ba̱ ilgon nisi ɗa̱ sowu kum ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya ma̱n ta̱mti.
Nya a ba̱l hwa wul ma̱jwe zak za̱t mbadl tena̱n sowu.”
Kaal ɗa̱ za̱t gaa ga̱ ma̱n kopti ji Yohana, yek Yesu nde ga̱ɓa mbala̱mi tenti ɗe, “Wok nii ka̱ la̱ɓ ɗe ka̱ la yenti gwas wo? Ko ma̱lgwe ni na̱k tlal me jwe yeta̱l na̱ma nwuti wu ka̱n ka̱ la yenti?
Yek wok ka̱ la yenti gwas wo? Ma̱lgwe kinti na̱ hwa luka̱l gwa? Ma̱n lakti hwa luka̱l suk ma̱n da̱nti ta̱mti wo ɗa̱ guu ka̱n asa̱ ni.
Yek wok ka̱ la yenti wo? Ma̱n dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya ma? Nu ka̱n ni, ta̱ nal ma̱n dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya pamma.
Ti ka̱n ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya dla̱m ɗe, “‘Yen shinti gi a tulik cina, ma̱lgwe a la̱ka̱mik lu apaa ka̱ nda tulti wu.’
A ni kii ma hwiti, mas mbala̱n za̱ti ga̱ modli, gon nal na̱k Yohana so, ama ma̱lgwe tik ɗe nak'eni ka̱ ma̱jwe kan Nya ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl gwasa̱n wu nal manti.”
Mas ma̱jwe kum ga̱ɓe wu, mas na̱ ma̱n kanti wulpi boo sa̱ kan ka̱ mbadl gwasa̱n ɗe, tantu ga̱ Nya wo gem ka̱n, na̱k ɗe Yohana pa̱lisi baptisma wu.
Ama yek ma̱n Paresi suk ma̱n yisti mba̱t ga̱ Musa nge kopti ilgwe Nya lamisi kopti wu, na̱k ɗe sa̱ nge ta̱ Yohana pa̱lisi baptisma wu.
Yek Yesu wule, “Yek mbala̱n ten dii atl ninge ndaali ye? Ndakce suk yek sa̱ ni ye?
Sa̱ ni ndakce suk mil mbala̱n jwe ni ka̱lu motgaa wu ɗe sa̱ wul yilkeni ɗe, “‘Ma̱ hotiki mba̱zhel, yek ka̱ nge dlalti, ma̱ wul koo ma̱shka̱n yek ka̱ nge kulu.’
“Ɗe Yohana ma̱n baptisma tul go, a ba̱ta̱ nguk wul so, ba̱ta̱ tla ze inabi so, ama yek ka̱ wule, ‘Ma̱n ma̱zhe ka̱ɗe ti.’
Yek ami Yen ga̱ Mbala̱n tuli, a na̱ma ngukti wul a na̱ma tlati yek ka̱ wule, ‘Ɓo yena̱nti ta̱ nguk wul hwo ata̱ tla ze inabi i'e pak, yela̱n ji ma̱n kanti wulpi boo suk ma̱n pa̱lti byas wul.’
Mas na̱ nu go, ma̱jwe kan ɓotlka̱n gwe a Nya ba̱li wugo, sa̱ yisi ɗe ɓotlka̱mi wo gem ka̱n.”

Yek ba Paresi gon asa̱ mbet ɗe Siman mbe Yesu ta̱s nguk wul a lubii ɗatka, yek Yesu li lubiimi yek ta̱ da̱n na̱ zhila ta̱s nguki. Nu ka̱n a Ma̱n Yehuda pa̱li, kumɗe sa̱ ɓa nguk wul go asa̱ tlalti asa̱n a atli.

A kili gon ni ka̱ ba̱mi gwe pa̱l byas wul ka̱ da̱nti gwas wu. Yek ta̱ kumi ɗe Yesu na̱ma ngukti wul a lubii ɗa̱ ba Paresi wu ka, yek ta̱ kan bunta̱n mil gon teɗi na̱ mil ma̱n ta̱mi wusa̱n gwe asa̱ wul na̱ bal wulpi wu.

Yek ta̱ lak dla̱l a malka̱n ɗa̱ Yesu ka, ata̱ na̱ma kulu, a luu gwas na̱ma lokti ten asa̱n ga̱ Yesu. Yek ta̱ taasi ka na̱ ma̱dla̱n gaa gwasi. Yek ta̱ ngusi swatti asa̱n ga̱ Yesu ata̱ na̱ma pa̱t mil dani.

Yek ba Paresi wu yen ilgwe kili wu na̱ma pa̱lti wu wugo yek ta̱ wul ka̱ mbadl gwas ɗe, “Ma̱lga̱n go, Nya ka shinti ɗe ma̱n dla̱mti ga̱ɓa gwas go ɗa ta yis wunda̱l kili gwe na̱ma ta̱nti gwas wu ɗe ma̱n pa̱lti byas wul ka̱n.”
Yek Yesu wul ba Paresisi ɗe, “A lamik hwit ilgon.” Yek ta̱ wulti ɗe, “Hwini, ma̱n lishti.”

Yek Yesu wule, “Ma̱lgon na̱ma kopti ji mbala̱n ɗe lop jon wulpi, gon wo ta̱ na̱ma kopti gwas wulpi gwe asa̱ ɓatl zhel ka̱ gin ɗe na̱m na̱ tatlti tlo wu, a gon wo ta̱ na̱ma kopti gwas wulpi gwe asa̱ ɓatl zhel ka̱ multi ɗe kutl ɗe namtan wu.
Yek ba̱sa̱ ɓatl dani sogo, yek ta̱ zakisi mas jwasa̱n. Ka̱ yenti gwa wo gwik ka lamti mani gwi?”
Yek Siman wulti ɗe, “Ka̱ yenti gi wo ma̱lgwe wulpi gwas wu nal mani wu.” Yek Yesu wule, “Gem ka̱n ka̱ dla̱mi.”

Yek ta̱ balla̱t mal kilisi yek ta̱ wul Siman ɗe, “Ɓo yen kili gee, a te boo ɗakka ba̱ka̱ ba̱la̱n ze ta pol asa̱n gi so, ama yek ta̱ pol asa̱n gi ka na̱ luu gwasi yek ta̱ taasi ka na̱ ma̱dla̱n gaa gwasi.

Na̱k a te boo ɗakka, ka̱ ga̱ɓe i'e so a ba̱ka ngiɓa̱n ni yek ka̱ wup kaal ka̱n gi so, ama na̱k a te teɗi yek kili ga̱n na̱ma ta wupti asa̱n gini. Pa̱lti ji Ma̱n Yehuda ka̱n kume sa̱ ɓa ga̱ɓe yilkeni go, asa̱ ngipsi te tlo ka asa̱ wup ga̱ska̱n gwasa̱n sogo ang gwasa̱n.
Ka̱ pi mil ten gaa so, ama ti wo ta̱ na̱ma tuksa̱t mil ten asa̱n gini.
Yek laki a nikma hwiti ɗe, wonti byas wul jwas jo mas a taasit ka̱wi na̱k ɗe ta̱ lama̱n i'e wu. Ma̱lgwe sa̱ taasit njet byas wul ka̱go, njet ka̱n ata̱ pa̱l lamti gwasi.”
Yek ta̱ wul kilisi ɗe, “Sa̱ taas byas wul jwa ka̱wi.”
Yek ma̱nda̱ki jwe na̱ma ngukti wul suksi wu wul yilkeni ɗe, “Wok ɗe ga̱n ɗe hal ata̱ taas byas wul ga̱ mbala̱n ka̱go?”
Yek Yesu wul kilisi ɗe, “Za̱t mbadl ten Nya gwa kiski wi; zigaa na̱ ta̱mi mbadli.”

Nak la̱m da̱nti wugo, yek Yesu ma̱tl ɗa̱nka̱ kiɗi ba̱n ka suk nak mili ata̱ na̱ma dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ma̱n ta̱mti ten kangwe mbala̱n a kan Nya ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl gwasa̱n wu, a ma̱n kopti jwas ɗe kutl cet lop ju ni sukti.
Suk modli jon jwe sa̱ yilli ma̱zhe ɗa̱ka̱si ka yek sa̱ ba̱lsi ndokti wu, ka̱ Maryam ma̱n Maga̱dala ma̱lgwe sa̱ yillit ma̱zhe ɗe nitgi ka̱wu,
Suk Yuwana kili ga̱ Kuza gwe ata̱ pa̱li wul Hiridus guu wu, suk Suzana, suk modli wonti jwe na̱ma pa̱lti wul suk Yesu suk ma̱n kopti jwas ɗe kutl cet lop ju na̱ wul ang jwasa̱n wu.
A mbala̱n na̱ma ta motgaa mal Yesu tet ka̱ ba̱n ɗa̱nka, yek Yesu wule, “Ha̱nta ɓo hwikii ga̱ɓa gon.
Ma̱lgon la catti wunda̱l ka̱ zhin gwasi, ta̱ na̱ma catti wuda̱li nugo, yek naami lok ten tantu yek mbala̱n koɓi dani yek yatl ɗakmi ka.
Yek naami lok ka̱ gokca, yek te wugo yek lada̱l ka, na̱k ɗe ba̱ lwisi ni diki i'e sowu.
Yek naami lok ka̱ iili, yek nal suk iili, yek iili ngap ka yek ba̱ kiɗi so.
Yek naa wuda̱li jon lok ka̱ hwa lu yek sa̱ kiɗi, yek pa̱l gwe nal.” Yesu pak ga̱ɓe wugo, yek ta̱ ga̱ɓa na̱ nda̱lti ɗe, “Ma̱lgwe ka̱n kumti niɗɗa̱ go, ha̱n ta̱s kumi.”
Yek ma̱n kopti jwas ngemti ilgwe ta̱ lamisi dla̱mti ka̱ ga̱ɓe wu.

Yek ta̱ wulsi ɗe, “Kii wo sa̱ ba̱lkii yisti wul gwe ni ga̱ hwuda̱li ga̱ kangwe mbala̱n a kan Nya ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl gwasa̱n wu, ama naa mbala̱n wo, a hwisi ga̱ɓa ga̱ hwuda̱li kangwe, ‘ko ta̱s yeni, sa man yenti so, ko ta̱s kumi, sa yis gaami so.’
“Ilgwe a lamikii dla̱mti go yek ɗe, wunda̱l go yek ɗe ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya.
Jwe lok ten tantu go sa̱ ni na̱k ma̱jwe kum ga̱ɓe yek Sheɗan kan ɗa̱ ten mbadl gwasa̱n ka, ba̱s zi mbadl gwasa̱n ten Nya asa̱ mbi kisti so.
Wuda̱l jwe lok ka̱ gokca go sa̱ ni na̱k ma̱jwe kum ga̱ɓe yek sa̱ kan na̱ hwol tuki, ama yek ba̱ dlunti ka̱si so. Sa̱ ba̱l gem njet yek bomti tulisi wugo yek sa̱ pal na̱ kaali.
Wuda̱l jwe lok ka̱ iil go sa̱ ni na̱k ma̱jwe kum ga̱ɓe ama yek da̱nti ga̱ se na̱ ayo suk lamti wul ji dii atli suk kumti ta̱mti da̱nti ngapsi yek ba̱ za̱t mbadl ten Nya gwasa̱n nda̱l so.
A wunda̱l jwe lok ka̱ hwa lu go, sa̱ ni na̱k ma̱jwe kum ga̱ɓe wu, yek sa̱ ngiɓi ka̱ mbadl gwasa̱n yek sa̱ tlo mbadli yek za̱t mbadl ten Nya gwasa̱n nda̱li, yek sa̱ pa̱l hwa da̱nti.
“Mbala̱n a lak wutu ten pitila ata̱ yitle ka na̱ ka̱sa̱l so, sogo ata̱ zi te ga̱s gobdlan ka̱ so, ama ta zi ten wul za̱ti kangwe mas ma̱n tet ka̱ biimi a yen cilti wu.
Mas ilgwe ni ga̱ hwuda̱li go a yil deɓa̱l, a mas ilgwe ni ga̱ yitle go a ɓuli.
Pa̱n ɗem'ɗem na̱ kangwe aka̱ kat ka̱n wu, na̱k ɗe ma̱lgwe ilgon niɗɗa̱ wu, sa mba̱lit dani, a ma̱lgwe ba̱ ilgon niɗɗa̱ sogo nak njeti gwe niɗɗa̱ wu mago sa kamit ka.”
Yek ana suk yilkeni ji Yesu tul malti, ama yek ba̱sa̱ mbi mbukti lu malti so na̱k ɗe mbala̱n wonti hwo wu.
Yek ma̱lgon wul Yesu ɗe, “Ana gwa suk yilkeni jwa ni deɓa̱l sa̱ na̱ma lamti yenti gwa.”
Yek Yesu wulti ɗe, “Ana gini suk yilkeni ji ka̱ɗe ma̱jwe kum ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya yek sa̱ koɓi wu.”
Gas gon yek Yesu wul ma̱n kopti jwas ɗe, “Ma̱ la̱n te ten ka̱t bi cikɗi ga̱ tekgu ka.” Yek sa̱ te ka̱ jirgi ze yek sa̱ njel la̱ti.
Sa̱ na̱ma la̱t nugo, yek yeba̱l kan Yesu, yek bal yeta̱l gon tli tot ka̱ zesi, yek ɓanti dopsi na̱k ɗe zesi ɓalma tet ka̱ jirgi wu.
Yek ma̱n kopti jwas pa̱da̱lti yek sa̱ wulti na̱ nda̱lti ɗe, “Ma̱n lishti, tlinya ka, ma̱ ɓa lam ma̱shka̱n!” Yek Yesu tlinya yek ta̱ matl yeta̱li suk ze gwe na̱ma tlit wu, yek zesi mul atli.
Yek Yesu ngemsi ɗe, “Za̱t mbadl gwaka̱n ɓal ko?” Yek ɓanti cisi, yek sa̱ wul yilkeni ɗe, “Wok ɗe ga̱n ɗe paa ata̱ matl yeta̱l suk ze gwe na̱ma tlit wu asa̱ kum ga̱ɓa gwas nu wo?”
Yek Yesu suk ma̱n kopti jwas ngusi la̱t ten ze yek sa̱ mbuki ten ka̱t atl ga̱ Garasina gwe ni ten ka̱t ang gon ga̱ zesi wu.
Yek Yesu yil tot ten bi cikɗi wugo, yek ma̱n ma̱zhe gon ka̱wu koo tlisi gwe ata̱ da̱m ka̱lu gwe asa̱ lep mbala̱n wu, ata̱ mul wonti ka̱li wi.
Na̱ yenti ga̱ Yesu, yek ta̱ nda a cina ɗatka yek ta̱ des lee, yek ta̱ wule, “Yek moo sukki ye, Yesu, yen ga̱ Nya Bal Kakshe? A na̱ma ngemti gwa ba̱k nola̱n so.”

Ta̱ dla̱m nu ɗe ta̱ Yesu huulti suk ma̱zhesi. A ma̱zhesi kul ɓoti ko ɗe asa̱n suk ang gwas wo ga̱ ɓali ka̱n ni na̱ zaa ga̱lla wu, a ma̱n ɓa̱tti gwas ni malti ama ata̱ ɓatl ka a ma̱zhesi mbolti te ka̱ me ka.
Yek Yesu ngemti ɗe shin gwa ka̱ɗe wokko? Yek ta̱ wule, “Wonti.” Na̱k ɗe ma̱zhe jwe ni ka̱ti go wonti ka̱n sa̱ ni wu.
Yek ma̱zhesi ngusi ngemti ga̱ Yesu ba̱s mbolsi te ka̱lu gwe sa da̱n ka̱ bomti wu so.
A wonti alade jon na̱ma kyo ten za̱nda̱l njaa mal bal zesi, yek ma̱zhesi ngem Yesu ɗe ta̱s zaksi ta̱s te gipsi, yek ta̱ zaksi.
Yek sa̱ yil ɗa̱ka̱ ma̱li ka yek sa̱ te ka̱ aladesi, yek aladesi tli na̱ apti yek sa̱ lok ka̱ bal zesi yek sa̱ ma̱shi.
Yek ma̱n kyo aladesi yeni nu wugo, yek sa̱ aɓi yek sa̱ lak hwi mbala̱n ɗa̱nka̱ ba̱n ka.
Yek mbala̱mi yili ta̱s lak yen ilgwe pi wu, yek sa̱ li tet mal Yesu wugo, yek sa̱ yen ma̱lgwe ma̱zhe yil ɗa̱ka̱ ti ka̱wu njaa mal Yesu na̱ luka̱l ten tli ata̱ ɓal hwaɓi, yek ɓanti njel cit gwasa̱n.
Yek ma̱jwe ni ka̱li ɗe ili pi wu, ngusi hwiti mbala̱n kangwe Yesu ndok ma̱li wu.
Yek mas mbala̱n ka̱ atl ga̱ Garasina ngem Yesu ta̱s zak ba̱mi na̱k ɗe ɓanti cisi i'e wu. Yek Yesu ɓa te ka̱ jirgi ta̱s zigaa go,
yek ma̱lgwe ta̱ yillit ma̱zhesi ka̱wu ngemti ɗe, “Ba kopki,” ama yek ba̱ Yesu zigaa sukti so.
Yek Yesu wulti ɗe, “Pal gee ta̱k dla̱m ilgwe Nya pa̱lik wu.” Yek ma̱li li ka̱ bal ba̱mi yek ta̱ ngusi dla̱mti ilgwe Yesu pa̱lit wu.
Yek Yesu pal te ten ka̱t bi bal ze gon wu ka̱wu yek mbala̱n wonti pa̱lit ɗem, na̱k ɗe ti ka̱n sa̱ na̱ma ɓa̱tti gwas wu.
Yek ma̱lgon ka̱wu asa̱ mbet ɗe Yayirus, bali ka̱n ka̱lu motgaa ga̱ gwasa̱n, yek ta̱ lak ngus a cina ɗa̱ Yesu ka ata̱ na̱ma ngemti gwas ɗe ta̱s li tet lubii ɗatka.
Yen gwas ɗe na̱m ga̱ ma̱dli ma̱n gin ɗe kutl cet lop ɓal njaa ta̱s ma̱shi. Yek Yesu ɓal ten tantu la̱t lubiimi go yek mbala̱n wonti ngusi kopti gwasi asa̱ na̱ma ɗamti njaa malti.
A kili gon ni ka̱ mbala̱mi gwe pa̱l gin ɗe kutl cet lop a hwulan nitma shoti wu, a ba̱ta̱ mbi ma̱lgwe a ndokti wu so.
Yek ta̱ te teka̱ mbala̱mi ka yek ta̱ li tukaal ɗa̱ Yesu ka yek ta̱ ta̱n bi luka̱l gwasi, ninge-ninge yek shoti hwulami tlo ang.
Yek Yesu wule, “Wok ta̱na̱n wo?” Yek kokko wule tik so, yek Siman Biturus wule, “Ma̱n lishti, mbala̱n wonti lakki tlo, asa̱ na̱ma ngapti gwa.”
Yek Yesu wule, “Ma̱lgon ta̱na̱nni, a kum nda̱lti yil tet ka̱ ami.”

Yek kilisi yeni go sa̱ yisit lu ka̱wi, yek ta̱ yil teɗi a tli gwas na̱ma da̱dalti yek ta̱ lak ngus a cina ɗa̱ Yesu ka, yek ta̱ dla̱mit ilgwe laki ɗe ta̱ ta̱nti wu suk kangwe ta̱ mbi ndokti ka̱li wu a cina ɗa̱ mbala̱n mas.
Yek Yesu wulti ɗe, “Kili mbala̱n, za̱t mbadl ten Nya gwa ndokki wi, zigaa na̱ ta̱mi mbadli.”
A ba̱ Yesu ɓo pak ga̱ɓe so, yek yen shinti ka̱ ɓal wu tet lubii ɗa̱ Yayirus ka, yek ta̱ hwi Yayirus ɗe, “Ba̱ ma̱n lishtisi po tlamba la̱t tet so, yeni ma̱sh wi.”
Yek Yesu kumi nu wugo, yek ta̱ wul Yayirus ɗe, “Ba̱ ɓanti cik so, zi mbadl ɗe ta tli ɗa̱ka̱ ma̱shka̱n ka.”
Sa̱ mbuk lu lubiimi wugo, yek ba̱ta̱ zak ma̱lgon ta̱s te ka̱ biimi sukti so se Biturus suk Yohana suk Yakubu suk aba na̱ ana ga̱ yeni.
Mas mbala̱n jwe ni ka̱ lubiimi go yek sa̱ pita kulu asa̱ na̱ma desti lee na̱ ma̱shka̱n ga̱ yen kilisi. Yek Yesu wulsi ɗe, “Po kula̱n so, yen kilisi ɓo ma̱sh so, yeba̱l ka̱n ta̱ na̱ma ndeti.”
Yek sa̱ mboshu ka̱ ga̱ɓe yek sa̱ gitlti, na̱k ɗe sa̱ yisi ɗe ta̱ ma̱sh wu.
Yek Yesu ngip ang ga̱ yeni, yek ta̱ ga̱ɓa na̱ nda̱lti ɗe, “Yen mbala̱n, tlinya.”
Yek mbadl gwas palli, yek ta̱ tlinya ninge, yek Yesu wulsi ɗe ta̱s ba̱lti ilga̱ nguki.
Yek ma̱n za̱t ga̱ yeni ngip bi ka̱ ang. Ama yek Yesu wulsi ɗe ba̱s hwi ma̱lgon so.
Yesu mo mil shinti ji botli jwas ɗe kutl cet lop wu, yek ta̱ ba̱lsi nda̱lti ta̱s yilli mas ma̱zhe ka suk ta̱s ndok mbala̱n ma̱n cwo wonti,
yek ta̱ shinsi ta̱s dla̱misi ga̱ɓa ten kangwe mbala̱n a kan Nya ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl gwasa̱n wu a ta̱s ndok mbala̱n.
Ta̱ wulsi ɗe, “Ba̱k kama̱n ilgon ang so ɗe ka̱ɓa li wu, ba̱k kama̱n sada so, a ba̱k kama̱n ngura so, a ba̱k kama̱n ilga̱ nguki so, a ba̱k kama̱n wulpi so, a ba̱k kama̱n luka̱l ɗe lop so.
Mas lubii gwe sa̱ kan ki wu, da̱ma̱n ka̱li, se gas gwe ka zigaa wu.
Mas ba̱n gwe nge kanti gwaka̱n wu, ka̱ɓa zak ba̱mi go aka̱ bat kushka ga̱ ba̱mi ɗa̱ ten asa̱n gwaka̱n ka, yek ka da̱n ɗe ilgwe a daamisi ga̱ɓa gwe ka̱ hwisi wu.”
Yek sa̱ yili yek sa̱ ngusi tet ɗa̱nka̱ ba̱mi ka asa̱ na̱ma dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya ma̱n ta̱mti asa̱ na̱ma ndokti ga̱ ma̱n cwo mas lu gwe sa̱ li wu.
Yek Hiridus guu kum ilgwe na̱ma pa̱t wu wugo yek ili hwotti i'e. Naa mbala̱n wule, Yohana ma̱n baptisma ka̱n Nya palla̱t na̱ mbadli.
Naa mbala̱mi jon wule Iliya ka̱ palli. Naami wo sa̱ wule ɗe na̱m ka̱ ma̱n dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya ji cina ka̱n Nya palla̱t kaami.
Yek Hiridus wule, “Yohana wo a laki yek sa̱ kotlit gaa ka̱wi, wok ɗe gwe a yima kumti wul wonti tenti go?” Yek ta̱ ngwe ta̱s yenti.
Mil shinti ji botlisi pal wugo, yek sa̱ hwi Yesu ilgwe sa̱ pa̱li wu, yek ta̱ li ka̱ ba̱n gon asa̱ mbe ɗe Betsaida suk mil shinti jwasi na̱ ngusa̱n.
Mbala̱n yeni nu wugo, yek sa̱ kopti wonti, yek ta̱ kan ma̱nda̱ki gwasa̱n yek ta̱ hwisi ga̱ɓa ten kangwe mbala̱n a kan Nya ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl gwasa̱n wu, yek ta̱ ndok ma̱n cwo.

Cin ɓal njaa ta̱ nda bii go, yek ma̱n kopti ɗe kutl cet lop ju, li tet malti yek sa̱ wulti ɗe, “Hwi mbala̱n jee ta̱s zigaa ta̱s lak ngo ilga̱ nguki suk lu gwe sa mul wu ɗa̱nka̱ ba̱n jwe ni njaa wu ka, a ɗee ɗe ma̱ na̱n go, a kansi so, aba̱ ilga̱ nguki ni ɗa̱ so.”
Yek Yesu wulsi ɗe, “Ba̱la̱nsi ilga̱ nguki ci la,” yek sa̱ wule, “Burodi ɗe namtan suk kwes ɗe lop ka̱ nini ɗa, kume nuk go ta̱n lak wuli ilga̱ nguki mbala̱mi teɗi.”
Maani zamba̱l kutl ɗe namtan ka̱ ni ka̱li. Yek ta̱ wul ma̱n kopti jwas ɗe, “Moosi kutl ɗe namtan-namtan asa̱ da̱m na̱ zhila.”
Yek sa̱ pa̱li nu, yek mas jwasa̱n sa̱ da̱m atli.
Yek Yesu kan burodi ɗe namtan wu, yek ta̱ tlil gaa nya yek ta̱ pa̱l hwol tuk na̱ Nya, yek ta̱ cal burodisi yek ta̱ ba̱l ma̱n kopti jwasi yek sa̱ hwuli mbala̱mi.
Yek sa̱ nguki yek kumsi yek sa̱ mo naami gwe sa wu hal njika̱n ga̱ɗa kutl cet lop.
Gas gon, Yesu na̱ma ngemti Nya na̱ ngusi yek ma̱n kopti jwas li tet malti yek ta̱ ngemsi ɗe, “Mbala̱n wule wok ɗe ami wo?”
Yek sa̱ wulti ɗe, “Mbala̱n wule Yohana ma̱n baptisma ka̱ɗe ki, naami wo sa̱ wule Iliya, a naami wo sa̱ wule ɗe na̱m ka̱ ma̱n dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya ji cina ka̱n Nya palla̱t kaami wi.”
Yek ta̱ wulsi ɗe, “A kii hwa? Ɗe wok ka̱a̱ yisa̱n wo?” Yek Siman Biturus wulti ɗe, “Kik ɗe Almasihu gwe Nya shinti sut wu.”
Yek Yesu hwisi ɗe ba̱s hwi ma̱lgon so.

Yek ta̱ wulsi ɗe, “Ngetli ka̱n ta̱ Yen ga̱ Mbala̱n tla bomti ten wul wonti, a kiɗi mbala̱n suk kiɗi ma̱n Pa̱ris suk ma̱n yisti mba̱t ga̱ Musa a ngeti, a mbala̱n a tloti. Ama ten ndat cin na̱ mekan wo Nya a palla̱t kaami.”
Yek ta̱ wul mbala̱mi mas jwasa̱n ɗe, “Mas ma̱lgwe lam da̱nti ɗe ma̱n kopti gi go, se ta̱ nge gaa gwasi, ata̱ lam tet ka̱ bomti ten da̱nti ɗe ma̱n kopti gini ko gasi.
Na̱ nu ka̱n mas ma̱lgwe lam gaa gwas man kopti gi go, ta mbi Nya boo so. Ama ma̱lgwe ba̱l gaa gwas ten kopti gi go, ta mbi Nya boo.
Yek ɗe ta̱mti ga̱ mbala̱n ye, ɗe ta̱ mbi mas hwa wul ten dii atli a ba̱ta̱ mbi Nya boo sowu?

Na̱ nu ka̱n mas ma̱lgwe nsha kopti gi citi suk ga̱ ga̱ɓa gi go, nsha yisti gwas a cinni ami Yen ga̱ Mbala̱n ɗe a pal sut na̱ nalti gini suk nalti ga̱ bal Aba gini suk ga̱ mil shinti ga̱ Nya ma̱n cilti wu.
Gem ka̱n a ni kii ma hwiti ɗe ma̱jon ni ka̱ kii jwe sa ma̱sh so se sa̱ yen gas gwe Nya a da̱n ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl gwasa̱n wu.”
Kaal ɗa̱ multi ɗe wusupsi ɗe Yesu pak dla̱mti ga̱ɓa wu, yek ta̱ kan ka̱ Biturus suk Yohana suk Yakubu, yek ta̱ to ka̱ tla̱da̱l suksi ta̱s ngem Nya.
Ta̱ ɓalma ngemti Nya go, yek cinagwel gwas balla̱ti, yek luka̱l gwas pal hwoli na̱ cilti hal na̱ma zhila̱kti gwel.
Sa̱ ni nugo yek mbala̱n ɗe lop ka̱wu, ka̱ Musa suk Iliya
ka̱ nalti ga̱ Nya asa̱ na̱ma ga̱ɓa sukti ten bi gas gwe ta pal to Nya ka̱wu suk ma̱shka̱n gwe ta ma̱sh a Wurshelima ta̱s njika̱n ilgwe Nya dla̱m wu.
Biturus suk ma̱jwe ni sukti wu dlenti ka̱ yeba̱l wi, ama yek sa̱ pa̱da̱l wugo yek sa̱ yen nalti gwasi suk mbala̱n ɗe lop jwe ni sukti wu.

Mbala̱n ɗe loɓi ɓa lam za̱tgaa go, yek Biturus wul Yesu ɗe, “Ma̱n lishti, mbuni ɗe ma̱ na̱n a ɗee wu, ha̱n ta̱n pa̱likii mil bii ɗe mekan, gon wo gwa a gon wo ga̱ Musa a gon wo ga̱ Iliya.” A ba̱ Biturus yis ilgwe ta̱ na̱ma dla̱mti wu so.
Ta̱ na̱ma dla̱mti nugo, yek kaluntun yitlasi ka, yek ɓanti njel cit gwasa̱n.
Yek ga̱ɓa wul sut ka̱ kaluntumi ɗe, “Ga̱n go tik ɗe yen gi gwe a botlti wu, kuma̱n ga̱ɓa gwasi.”
Yek ga̱ɓe paki wugo, yek sa̱ yen Yesu na̱ ngusi. Yek ba̱sa̱ hwi ma̱lgon ilgwe pi wu ka̱ multi jwisi so se ka̱ kaali.
Kaal ɗa̱ multi ɗe na̱m, yek sa̱ yil sut ɗa̱ka̱ tla̱nda̱li ka̱ wugo yek mbala̱n wonti mbi Yesu.
Yek ma̱lgon ka̱ mbala̱mi wule, “Ma̱n lishti, a na̱ma ngemti gwa ta̱k yen gonti ga̱ yen gini, tik ni ɗa na̱ ngusi.
A ma̱zhe kul twet ka̱ gaa, ata̱ lak yal, a ma̱zhesi ɓot ten atli, a bi gwas yilli hwol ɓaka̱n. A ba̱ta zakti so se ta̱ kumit cwo na̱k wule ta tloti.
Yek a ngem ma̱n kopti jwa ta̱s yilla̱si ka yek ba̱sa mani so.”

Yek Yesu wulsi ɗe, “Kii mbala̱n ji se wo ka̱a̱ zi mbadl ten Nya so a ma̱n yokit ka̱ɗe kii, hal a gasi ka̱n ba da̱n sukkii a na̱ma tlot mbadl na̱ la̱shi za̱t mbadl gwaka̱n ten Nya gwi? Ta̱la yeni teɗi.”
Yeni ɓa li tet mal Yesu go yek ma̱zhesi ɓot ten atli. Yek Yesu matl ma̱zhesi, yek ta̱ ndok yeni, yek ta̱ ba̱ltiti aba gwasi.
Yek ɓanti cisi, ɗe sa̱ yen nalti ga̱ Nya wu yek sa̱ ngip bi ka̱ ang. A sa̱ yima yenti wul cit ɓanti gwe Yesu pa̱li wu, yek ta̱ wul ma̱n kopti jwas ɗe,
“Ba̱k ma̱sa̱na̱n ilgwe ba hwikii wu so. Sa ba̱l bi gini ami Yen ga̱ Mbala̱n a ang ɗa̱ byas mbala̱n ka.”
Ama yek ba̱sa̱ yis ilgwe ta̱ nisi ma hwiti wu so, ga̱ hwuda̱li ka̱n ni malsi, a ɓanti kumti ga̱zi na̱ma cit gwasa̱n.
Yek ga̱ɓa nda ka̱ dlo ji ma̱n kopti ji Yesu ten ɗe wok ka da̱n ɗe bali ka̱si wo.
Yek Yesu yis daamti gwasa̱n yek ta̱ kan nak'en yen gon yek ta̱ za̱t njaa malti.

Yek ta̱ wulsi ɗe, “Mas ma̱lgwe kan nak'en yen mbala̱n na̱k ga̱n ka̱ lal gi go, ami ka̱n ta̱ kama̱nni. A ma̱lgwe kama̱n go, ta̱ kan ma̱lgwe shina̱n sut wu. Ma̱lgwe tik ɗe nak'eni ka̱ kii mas go, tik ɗe bali.”
Yek Yohana wul Yesu ɗe, “Ma̱n lishti, ma̱ yen ma̱lgon ta̱ na̱ma yilla̱t ga̱ ma̱zhe ka ka̱ shin gwa, yek ma̱ hwit ɗe ta̱s zaki na̱k ɗe ba̱ta̱ ni ka̱ mi sowu.”
Yek Yesu wulsi ɗe, “Zaka̱nti, ma̱jwe ngekii sogo gwaka̱n ka̱n.”
Ta̱ ɓal njaa ta̱s pal to Nya ka̱go yek ta̱ zi ka̱ mbadl gwas ɗe ta li Wurshelima.
Yek ta̱ shin mil shinti cina ɗati ta̱s la̱ka̱misi lu ka̱ ba̱n Samariya gon.
Yek ma̱n ba̱mi nge kanti ga̱ Yesu na̱k ɗe sa̱ yisi ɗe a Wurshelima ka̱n ta̱ lam sut wu.
Ma̱n kopti jwasi ka̱ Yakubu suk Yohana yeni nu wugo, yek sa̱ wul Yesu ɗe, “Bagaa, ka̱ lami ta̱n mbe wutu sut nya ta̱ kwelsi ka?”
Yek Yesu balla̱t malsi yek ta̱ matlsi.
Yek sa̱ li ka̱ ba̱mi gon.
Sa̱ na̱ma la̱t ten tantu, yek ma̱lgon wul Yesu ɗe, “Ba kopki mas lu gwe ka li wu.”
Yek Yesu wulti ɗe, “Gwengwen wo shu da̱nti nisi ɗa, yatl mago lumulti nisi ɗa, ama ami Yen ga̱ Mbala̱n wo lumulti niɗɗa̱ so.”
Yek ta̱ po wul ma̱lgon ɗa̱ɗe, “Koɓa̱nni.” Yek ma̱li wulti ɗe, “Bagaa, ha̱nta ɓa̱t ma̱shka̱n ga̱ aba gini aa lepti paa.”
Yek Yesu wulti ɗe, “Zak ma̱jwe ma̱sh wu ta̱s lep yilkeni jwasa̱n, ama ki wo lak dla̱mi mbala̱n ga̱ɓa ten kangwe sa kan Nya ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl gwasa̱n wu.”
Yek ma̱lgon po wulti ɗa̱ɗe, “Bagaa, ami wo ba kopki, ama ha̱nta lak palli bi a lubii paa.”
Yek Yesu wulti ɗe, “Mas ma̱lgwe nda gut zhin na̱ gil tla ata̱ na̱ma celti gwel kaal go, ta man kanti ga̱ Nya ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl gwas so.”
Kaal ɗa̱ nugo yek Bagaa Yesu botl mbala̱n ɗe kutl ɗe nitgi na̱ lop jon yek ta shinsi lop-lop ka̱ ba̱n jwe ta̱ lam la̱t na̱ gaa gwas wu.
Yek ta̱ wulsi ɗe, “Zhimi nali, aba̱ ma̱n wotlti wonti so. Ngema̱n ma̱n zhimi, ta̱s shin ma̱n wotlti teɗi ta̱s wotli.
La̱nni, a shinti, na̱k mil mba̱la ka̱ tlo ji hwuli.
Ba̱k kama̱n wulpi ko ngura ko kapta̱lan ang so, a ba̱k da̱ma̱n ɗe ka ga̱ɓe ma̱lgon ten tantu so.
“Mas lubii gwe ka̱ te giɓi wu aka̱ wule, ‘Ta̱mi mbadl ka̱ lubii gee.’
Kume ma̱n hwol tuk ni ka̱ lubiimi go hwol tuk gwaka̱n a da̱miti. A kume ma̱n hwol tuk ni ka̱ lubiimi sowu, ta̱mi mbadl gwaka̱n a pallikii.
Da̱ma̱n ka̱ lubiimi aka̱ nguki aka̱ tla mas ilgwe sa̱ ba̱lkii wu na̱k ɗe ma̱lgwe pa̱l ilga̱ pa̱li go ta mbi ɓatlti gwasi wu. Ba̱k koɓa̱n lubii ɗa̱nka̱ so.
“Kume ka̱a̱ te ka̱ ba̱n yek sa̱ pikii ɗem wu, nguka̱n mas ilgwe sa̱ ba̱lkii wu.
Ndoka̱n ma̱n cwo ka̱ ba̱mi aka̱ hwisi ɗe, ‘Cin gwe mbala̱n a kan Nya ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl gwasa̱n wu ɓal njaa malkii.’
Ama kume ka̱a̱ te ka̱ ba̱n yek ba̱sa̱ pikii ɗem sogo, aka̱ yil ɗa̱n ten tantu ba̱mi ka aka̱ wulsi ɗe,
‘Kushka ga̱ ba̱n gwaka̱n mago ma bat ɗa̱ ten asa̱n ga̱na̱n ka̱wi. Ama ta̱k yisi ɗe cin gwe mbala̱n a kan Nya ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl gwasa̱n ɓal njaa malki.’
A ni kii ma hwiti ɗe, gas pakti ga̱ dii atl wo, Nya a yen gonti ga̱ ma̱n Sodom man ma̱n ba̱n wu.

“Ka̱a̱ da̱n ɗe wul cit gonti wi ma̱n Korazin suk Betsaida, wul cit ɓanti gwe sa̱ pa̱likii wu ka̱n sa pa̱li ma̱n Taya suk ma̱n Sidon go, sa ci atl gaa wi ba̱ sen so. Sa lak gus luka̱l asa̱ da̱n ka̱ mba̱tla̱l asa̱ daamsi ten byas wul jwe sa̱ pa̱li wu.
Gas pakti ga̱ dii atl wo, Nya a yen gonti ga̱ ma̱n Taya suk Sidon mankii.
Kii ma̱n Kaparnahum, ka̱ da̱ma̱n gwa we Nya a kankii to nya ka? Ko njaa! Nya a sulkii aka̱ da̱nti ga̱ ma̱n ma̱shka̱n.
“Mas ma̱lgwe kum ga̱ɓa gwaka̱n go ta̱ kumti ga̱ɓa gini wi, mas ma̱lgwe nge kumti ga̱ɓa gwaka̱n go ta̱ nge kumti ga̱ɓa gini, mas ma̱lgwe nge kumti ga̱ɓa gi go ta̱ nge Nya ma̱lgwe shina̱n wu.”
Yek mbala̱n ɗe kutl ɗe nitgi na̱ lop ju palli na̱ hwol tuki yek sa̱ wul Yesu ɗe, “Bagaa, ma̱zhe mago asa̱ kum ga̱ɓa ga̱na̱n ɗe ma̱ hwisi ga̱ɓa ka̱ shin gwa wu.”
Yek Yesu wulsi ɗe, “A yen Sheɗan nda sut nya na̱k nyaze gwe ci bi sut nya wu.
A ba̱lki nda̱lti gwe ka li ka̱ dlo ji wuci suk yenda̱l a ba̱sa pa̱likii ilgon sowu, aka̱ mani na̱ ma̱n nget gwaka̱n Sheɗan.
Mas na̱ nu, ba̱k pa̱la̱n hwol tuk ɗe ma̱zhe kum ga̱ɓa gwaka̱n so, ama pa̱la̱n hwol tuk ɗe shin gwaka̱n ni ga̱ lishi a nya.”

Ka̱ multi jwisi, yek Yesu njika̱n na̱ hwol tuk ga̱ Shishi ga̱ Nya yek ta̱ wule, “A pa̱l hwol tuk na̱ ki, Aba gini, Bagaa ga̱ nya suk dii atli, ɗe ka̱ hwuda̱li mas wul ju ma̱n ɓotlka̱n suk ma̱n yisti wul, yek ka̱ ba̱l yisti nak mil mbala̱n wu. Nu ka̱n ni, Aba, ɗe mbuniki ta̱k pa̱li nu wu.
“Aba gi ba̱la̱n wul mas. Ma̱lgon yis yeni wu so, se Abe na̱ ngusi. A ba̱ ma̱lgon yis Abe so se yeni suk ma̱jwe yeni lami ɗe ta̱ ba̱lsi yisti wu.”
Yek Yesu balla̱t mal ma̱n kopti jwasi, yek ta̱ hwisi na̱ ngusa̱n ɗe, “Kii wo ma̱n mbit hwa wul ka̱n ɗe gwel gwaka̱n yenikii ilgwe ka̱ yeni wu.
A ni kii ma hwiti, ma̱n dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya wonti suk guu lami ta̱s yen ilgwe ka̱ yeni, yek ba̱sa̱ yeni so, ta̱s kum ilgwe ka̱ kumi wu yek ba̱sa̱ kumi so.”
Gas gon ma̱n yisti mba̱t ga̱ Musa gon tlinya ka̱ mbala̱n ta̱s cinga̱l yisti Yesu, yek ta̱ wulti ɗe, “Ma̱n lishti, yek nii ngetli ɗe ta pa̱li a mbi Nya boo ye?”
Yek Yesu ballit ɗe, “Yek mba̱t ga̱ Musa dla̱m ye? Nii ka̱n ka̱ yisi gwi?”
Yek ma̱li wule, “‘Lam Bagaa Nya gwa na̱ mas mbadl gwa na̱ mas yisti gwa na̱ mas nda̱lti gwa, aka̱ lam yela̱n da̱nti gwa na̱k gaa gwa.’”
Yek Yesu wule, “Gem ka̱n ka̱ dla̱mi, ka̱ pa̱li nugo, ka mbi Nya boo.”
Yek ba̱ ma̱li lami ɗe ta̱ Yesu ngipti na̱ byas wul so, yek ta̱ wule, “Wok ɗe yela̱n da̱nti gi wo?”

Yek Yesu hwisi ga̱ɓa gon yek ta̱ wule, “Gas gon ma̱lgon yil sut Wurshelima ta su Jeriko, yek ta̱ mo suk kiɗi muka̱l ma̱n ɓa̱tti tantu. Yek sa̱ dopti, yek sa̱ ɓoti, yek sa̱ yemit wul ka, yek sa̱ zakti a atli na̱k hwuuni.
Yek bal ma̱n Pa̱ris gon yil sut Wurshelima pak, yek ta̱ yen ma̱lgwe muka̱l dopti yek sa̱ ɓot wu, yek ta̱ tlat a malka̱n ɗatka yek ta̱ zigaa ilgon gwasi.
Yek yen shinti ga̱ bal ma̱n da̱nti ka̱ bii ngemti Nyami koɓi tuka̱li pak yek ta̱ yenti a atli, yek ta̱ zigaa ilgon gwas pak.
Ni nugo, yek ma̱lgon yil tot Samariya yek ta̱ yen ma̱li a atli yek gonti gwas citi.
Yek ta̱ li tet malti yek ta̱ polit lu gwe sa̱ wotlti wu ka, yek ta̱ wutit ika̱n dani. Yek ta̱ kanti ten zhaki gwasi yek ta̱ ta̱lat ka̱lu multi ga̱ ma̱nda̱ki.
Sa̱ mul ɗe na̱m wugo, yek ta̱ ba̱l wulpi ma̱n lubiimi. Yek ta̱ wulti ɗe, ‘Yeni ma̱li gee, kume ka̱ tlo wulpi nal man gwe a ba̱lki wugo ba palliki ɗe a pal wu.’”
Yek Yesu ngem ma̱n yisti mba̱ti ɗe, “Ka̱ mbala̱n ɗe mekan jo, wok ɗe yela̱n da̱nti ga̱ ma̱lgwe te ang ɗa̱ muka̱l go?”
Yek ma̱li balli Yesu ɗe, “Ma̱lgwe yen gonti ga̱ ma̱li wu.” Yek Yesu wulti ɗe, “Ki mago lak pa̱li nu.”
Yesu suk ma̱n kopti jwas ni ten tantu Wurshelima yek sa̱ te ka̱ yen ba̱n gon gwe kili gon asa̱ mbet ɗe Marta kan ma̱nda̱ki gwasi a lubii ɗaat ka̱wu.
A yilka gon ni Marta ɗa asa̱ mbet ɗe Maryam ma̱lgwe da̱m njaa mal Bagaa Yesu ata̱ na̱ma kumti ga̱ɓa gwas wu.
Marta wo ta̱ na̱ma ta pa̱lti ilga̱ nguki, yek ta̱ li mal Yesu yek ta̱ wulti ɗe, “Bagaa, ka̱ yen kangwe yilka gi zaka̱n na̱ ngwe ɗe a na̱ma pa̱lti mas wul wu sa, hwiti ta̱s lak zi ang.”
Yek Bagaa Yesu wulti ɗe, “Marta, mbadl gwa tli ten ga̱ɓa ga̱n, wul wonti na̱ma hwotti gwa.
Wul ɗe na̱m ka̱n ka daamki dani. Maryam botl ilgwe mbun wu aba̱ ma̱lgon a kamit ka̱ so.”
Gas gon, Yesu na̱ma ngemti Nya ka̱lu gon. Ta̱ paki wugo, yek ɗe na̱m ka̱ ma̱n kopti jwas wulti ɗe, “Bagaa, mbokinii ang ten kangwe ma ngem Nya wu, na̱k kangwe Yohana mboki ang ma̱n kopti jwas wu.”
Yek Yesu wulsi ɗe, “Ka̱a̱ ɓa ngem Nya go aka̱ wule, ‘Nya bal Aba, ta̱ nalli shin gwa ma̱n cilti, da̱m ɗe guu ka̱ mbala̱n mas ten dii atli.
Ba̱lnii ilga̱ nguki ga̱ mas cin.
A ka̱ taasini byas wul jina̱n ka na̱k gwe ama̱ taas ga̱ yilkeni ɗa̱ ten mbadl ga̱na̱n ka̱wu. Ba̱k zakni ta̱n pa̱l byas wul so.’”
Yek Yesu po wul ma̱n kopti jwas ɗa̱ɗe, “Wok nii ka̱ kii gwe ɗe ta li mal yela̱n da̱nti gwasi ka̱ tlo gasi ata̱ ngemit duul burodi ɗe mekan, yek ta̱ wulti ɗe,
‘Yekgu yela̱n gon gi tul mala̱nni tet ka̱lu gon, aba̱ ilga̱ nguki gwe ba ba̱lti wu ni ɗa̱ so.’
“A paa yela̱n da̱nti gwe ta̱ la ngot burodi malti wu wul tet punka ɗe, ‘Ba̱k hwota̱n so, ma̱ le dlabii ga̱na̱n ka̱wi, ma̱ mul atl wi suk mil jini bama̱n tlat nya a ba̱lki ilgon so.’
A ni kii ma hwiti ɗe ta tlinya ata̱ ba̱lti ilgon ten ɗe ti wo yela̱n da̱nti gwas so, ama na̱k ɗe ta̱ ngaɓit na̱k ngemti wu ta tlinya ata̱ ba̱lti mas ilgwe ta̱ lami wu.
“A ni kii ma hwiti ɗa̱ɗe, pa̱nta ngemti, Nya a ba̱lkii. Pa̱nta ngoti, ka mbi. Pa̱nta kotlti dlabiimi, Nya a ɓulikii.
Mas ma̱lgwe ngemi go, Nya a ba̱lti. Ma̱lgwe ngwe go, ta mbi. Ma̱lgwe ɓo dlabiimi go, Nya a ɓuliti.
“Wok yen gwas a ngemit kwes ka̱ kii, ata̱ ba̱lti wuci wo?
Sogo, ta̱ yen gwas ngemit mbutli, ata̱ ba̱lti yenda̱l wo?
Kume kii ma̱n pa̱lti byas wul yek ka̱ yis kangwe ka ba̱l hwa wul mil jwaka̱n go, ɗa̱ nii ka̱n a kan bal Aba ga̱na̱n ga̱ to nya ka̱wu gaa gwi, ti ɗe ta ba̱l Shishi ga̱ Nya ma̱jwe ngemti wu.”
Gas gon Yesu na̱ma yilla̱t ga̱ ma̱zhe gwe ba̱ta ga̱ɓa sowu ɗa̱ka̱ ma̱lgon ka. Yek ma̱zhesi yil ka̱ wugo, yek ma̱li ga̱ɓa yek ɓanti ci mbala̱n.
Yek naa mbala̱mi wule, “Guu ga̱ ma̱zhe ka̱ ba̱lti nda̱lti yilla̱t ma̱zhe ka.”
Naa mbala̱mi jon lami ta̱s yen ilgwe ta pa̱li wu, yek sa̱ wulti ɗe, “Pa̱lini wul cit ɓanti, ta̱n yisi ɗe sut mal nya ka̱n ka̱ ni.”

Yek Yesu yis daamti gwasa̱n wugo yek ta̱ wulsi ɗe, “Kume mbala̱n ka̱ ba̱n ɗe na̱m dlansi ten tli gwasa̱n go, ba̱mi a dla̱l so, nu ka̱n mas lubii gwe calti ɗe lop asa̱ na̱ma nget ji yilkeni go lubiimi a nda.
Kume Sheɗan calti ɗe lop ata̱ na̱ma nget ga̱ gaa gwas go, nii ka̱n nalti gwas a dla̱l gwi? Ka̱a̱ wule, na̱ nda̱lti ga̱ guu ma̱zhe ka̱n a na̱ma yilla̱t ga̱ ma̱zhe ka.
Kume ka̱ wule, na̱ nda̱lti ga̱ guu ma̱zhe ka̱n a na̱ma yilla̱t ma̱zhe ka̱go, a kii hwa, na̱ nda̱lti ga̱ wok aka̱ yilli ma̱zhesi ka̱ wo?
Ama kume na̱ nda̱lti ga̱ Nya ka̱n a na̱ma yilla̱t ga̱ ma̱zhe ka̱go, cin gwe mbala̱n a kan Nya ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl gwasa̱n wu ɓa tuli.
“Kume nda̱li mbala̱n na̱ buula gwas da̱n na̱ ka̱n gaa ten ɓa̱t boo gwas go, ilgon a ta̱n wul lubii gwas so.
Ama kume ma̱lgwe nda̱l manti wu tuli, yek ta̱ ndat na̱ dlanti, yek ta̱ man ngetl gwas go ta yem mas buula jwas jwe ta̱ nda̱l giɓi wu ka, ata̱ hwuli mbala̱n mas wul jwasi.
“Ma̱lgwe ni suk ami sogo, nget ka̱n ta̱ na̱ma nget gini; ma̱lgwe na̱ma mooti suk ami sogo, ta̱ na̱ma catti ka.

A kume duu ma̱zhe yil ɗa̱ka̱ tli ga̱ mbala̱n ka̱ wu, ata̱ ngusi ma̱tlti ɗa̱nka̱ me ka ka̱lu gwe ba̱ ze ni ɗa̱ sowu ta̱s mbi lu shukti. Kume ta̱ mbi sowu, apaa ta̱ wule, ‘Ha̱n ta̱ pal te ka̱ ma̱lgwe a yil tet wu ka.’
Kume ta̱ lak mbi mbadl ma̱li sa̱ taasi ka yek sa̱ la̱ka̱mi ka̱ wu,
ata̱ lak yem ma̱zhesi jon teɗi ɗe nitgi jwe yoki manti wu ta̱s lak da̱n ka̱li. Pakti da̱nti ga̱ ma̱llu a lil man kangwe ta̱ nda zhile wu.”
Yesu dla̱m nu wugo, yek kili gon wulti na̱ nda̱lti ɗe, “Ta Nya ba̱l hwa wul kili gwe zaki yek ta̱ ngipki yek ka̱ nal wu.”
Yek Yesu wulti ɗe, “Nu ka̱n ni, ama ma̱jwe kum ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya yek sa̱ koɓi wu mbi hwa wul mani.”
Mbala̱n ngusi mba̱lti wonta̱t mal Yesu wu, yek ta̱ nda wulti gwasa̱n ɗe, “Mbala̱n ji se wo byas mbala̱n ka̱n, lamti gwasa̱n wo ta̱ pa̱lisi wul cit ɓanti ama ba̱sa yeni so se ga̱ Yona wu.
Na̱k gwe Yona da̱n ɗe wul cit ɓanti mal ma̱n Neniba wu, nu ka̱n ami Yen ga̱ Mbala̱n a da̱mi mbala̱n ji se.

Gas pakti ga̱ dii atl wo, guu ga̱ ma̱dli tet Sheba a kudu a tlinya suk mbala̱n ji se, ata̱ hwisi ɗe sa̱ pa̱l hwa wul so. Ta̱ tul tet dlenti ta̱s kum ga̱ɓa ɓotlka̱n ga̱ guu Sulemanu, yek ma̱lgwe man Sulemanu wuk ɓal wu.
Gas pakti ga̱ dii atl wo, ma̱n Neniba a tlinya suk mbala̱n ji se asa̱ hwisi ɗe sa pa̱l hwa wul so na̱k ɗe si wo sa̱ ci atl gaa ɗe Yona hwisi ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya wu, a yekgu ma̱lgwe man Yona wuk ɓal wu.
“Mbala̱n a lak wutu ten pitila ata̱ hwuda̱li ka̱ so, sogo ata̱ yitle ka na̱ gal so, ama ta zi ka̱lu gwe mas ma̱lgwe te ka̱ biimi wu a yen cilti wu.
Gwel ka̱ɗe cilti ga̱ tli, kume gwel gwa ni hwaɓi wu, tli gwa ani na̱ cilti, ama kume gwel gwa ni hwaɓi sogo, mas tli gwa ani ka̱ da̱mshal.
Pa̱n ɗem'ɗem ba̱ cilti gwaka̱n da̱n ɗe da̱mshal so.
Kume mas tli gwa ni na̱ cilti wu, da̱mshal ani kii ɗa̱ so, mas a da̱m na̱ cilti na̱k gwe a pitila cilli lu wu.”
Yesu pak ga̱ɓe wugo, yek ba Paresi gon mbet a lubii ɗatka ta̱s nguk wul, yek Yesu li ka̱ lubiimi ta̱s nguki.
Yek ba Paresisi yeni ɗe Yesu pol ang paa ta̱ nda ngukti na̱k kangwe a Ma̱n Yehuda pa̱li wu sogo, yek ili hwotti.
Yek Yesu wulti ɗe, “Kii ma̱n Paresi wo aka̱ pol mbuka ze suk gali, ama mbadl gwaka̱n ni ga̱ njikmi na̱ lamti mot wul suk yokiti.
Ka̱dla̱n ka̱ɗe kii, ka̱ yisi ɗe Nya gwe pa̱l tukaali wu ka̱ pa̱l tugiɓi pak sa?
Ka ba̱l ilga̱ nguki ma̱jwe ba̱ ilgon nisi ɗa̱ sowu tot ka̱ gal gwe aka̱ poli wu, a mbuni kii mal Nya mani.

“Ka̱a̱ da̱n ɗe wul cit gonti wi ma̱n Paresi, na̱k ɗe aka̱ ba̱l Nya ɗe na̱m ka̱ kutl ka̱ wul jwe aka̱ mbi wu na̱k wul wolo suk dik daa suk mitlgulu suk ngum, ama zok da̱nti suk lamti Nya wo yek ba̱ hwotkii so. Ngetli ka̱n ta̱k koɓa̱n jwisi, ama ba̱k zaka̱n jon ju so.
“Ka̱a̱ da̱n ɗe wul cit gonti wi ma̱n Paresi, na̱k ɗe lamti gwaka̱n wo ta̱s ba̱lkii hwa lu da̱nti ka̱lu motgaa ga̱ gwasa̱n ata̱ mbala̱n pita ga̱ɓet gwaka̱n ka̱lu motgaa wulti wul.

“Ka̱a̱ da̱n ɗe wul cit gonti wi, kii ma̱n Paresi na̱k gaa zukɗi gwe ba̱ mbala̱n a yeni sowu ka̱n ka̱ ni, jwe mbala̱n jwaka̱n na̱ma la̱t dani a ba̱sa̱ yisi ɗe yek ka laki asa̱ da̱n ɗe ma̱n da̱ska̱n sowu.”
Yek gon ka̱ ma̱n yisti mba̱t ga̱ Musa wul Yesu ɗe, “Ma̱n lishti, kume ka̱ dla̱m nugo, mi mago ka̱ byal nii.”
Yek Yesu wule, “Ka̱a̱ da̱n ɗe wul cit gonti wi, kii ma̱n yisti mba̱t ga̱ Musa, na̱k ɗe ka̱a̱ zi diɓa̱l mba̱t mbala̱n ama kii wo ba̱ka zisi ang ta̱s man kopti ɗa̱ sowu.
“Ka̱a̱ da̱n ɗe wul cit gonti wi na̱k ɗe ka̱a̱ kin gaa zukɗi ga̱ ma̱n dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya mbuni jwe ma̱jwaka̱n ji cina tlosi wu.

Kii na̱ gaa gwaka̱n, ka̱ yisi yek ka̱ kan ka̱ mbadl gwaka̱n ilgwe mbala̱n jwaka̱n ji cina pa̱li wu. Sa̱ tlo ma̱n dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya yek kii ne go yek ka̱ kop kaal gwasa̱n ɗe ka̱ kin gaa zukɗi jwasa̱n mbuni wu.
Yek laki yek Nya wul ka̱ yisti gwas ɗe, ‘Ba shinisi lu na̱ mil shinti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya suk mil shinti ji botli, mbala̱n a tlo naami, asa̱ nol naami.’
Na̱ nu ka̱n Nya a dop mbala̱n ji se na̱ byas wul jwasa̱n ɗe sa tlo mas ma̱n dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya tet ten ndat zhila da̱nti ka̱ dii atli.

Nde tet ten hwulan ga̱ Habila yek su sut ten ga̱ Zakariya, ma̱lgwe sa̱ tlot ka̱ tlo ga̱ lu takti wul Nya ka̱lu ma̱n cilti ka̱ lubii ga̱ Nya wu. Gem ka̱n a ni kii ma hwiti, sa dop mbala̱n ji se na̱ mas byas wul jwisi.
“Ka̱a̱ da̱n ɗe wul cit gonti wi, kii ma̱n yisti mba̱t ga̱ Musa, na̱k ɗe ka̱a̱ yis mba̱ti yek ka̱a̱ nge kopti kii gaa gwaka̱n, a ba̱ka̱a̱ zak ma̱lgon ta̱s yisi so.”
Yesu zak lwisi wugo, yek ma̱n yisti mba̱t ga̱ Muse suk ma̱n Paresi nda ngabti gwasi, yek sa̱ ngusit ngot bi na̱ kumti ga̱s wul wonti.
Sa̱ na̱ma ngoti ta̱s telti ka̱ ga̱ɓa gwe ba̱ta man yilti ɗa̱ giɓi ka̱ sowu a ta̱s dla̱m ilgwe ba̱ yek sowu.

Yek mbala̱n wonti mogaa mal Yesu hal wonta̱t gwasa̱n laki yek sa̱ na̱ma za̱t asa̱n ten ji yilkeni, yek Yesu nde hwit ga̱ɓa ma̱n kopti jwasi yek ta̱ wulsi ɗe, “Pa̱n ɗem'ɗem ba̱k shela̱n lal yisti Nya na̱k ga̱ ma̱n Paresi wu ka̱ da̱nti gwaka̱n so.
Ilgon ni ga̱ hwuda̱li gwe ba̱ a yil deɓa̱l sowu so. Sogo ga̱ hwuda̱li ɗe ba̱ mbala̱n a yisi sowu so.
Ilgwe ka̱a̱ dla̱m ka̱ da̱mshal go a yil ten cilti. Ilgwe ka̱ dla̱m ga̱ hwuda̱li te punka ka̱go a kumi ten za̱nda̱l.
“A ni kii ma hwiti kii yela̱n jini, ba̱k ɓanti ma̱jwe a tloki wu, kaal ɗa̱ nugo a ba̱sa po man pa̱lti ilgon sowu so.
Ama ba hwiki ma̱lgwe ka ɓantit wu, tik ɗe Nya ma̱lgwe kaal ɗa̱ tlot ga̱ tlisi ta man lakti gwaka̱n ka̱ boo wutu. Gem, ɓantiti.
Ale yatl ɗe namtan wo kobo ɗe lop ka̱n asa̱ wul ka̱ nwa? Mas na̱ nu, Nya ma̱sa̱n gon gwasa̱n so.
Ma̱dla̱n gaa gwaka̱n mago ga̱ dla̱mi ka̱n ni mas. Ba̱ ɓanti cikii so, ka̱ ni hwaɓi man wonti yadli.
“A ni kii ma hwiti ɗe mas ma̱lgwe dla̱m ka̱ mbala̱n ɗe ta̱ yisa̱n go, ami Yen ga̱ Mbala̱n a yisti a cina ɗa̱ mil shinti ji Nya ka.
Ma̱lgwe nge yisti gi a cina ɗa mbala̱n ka̱go, ami mago ba nge yisti gwas a cina ɗa̱ mil shinti ji Nya ka.
Mas ma̱lgwe dla̱m ga̱ɓa mbulti ten ami Yen ga̱ Mbala̱n go sa taasit ka, ama ma̱lgwe dla̱m ga̱ɓa nget ga̱ Shishi ga̱ Nya go sa taasit ka̱ so.
“Kume sa̱ ta̱lakii ka̱lu motgaa ga̱ gwasa̱n sogo mal guu ji ba̱n sogo mal kiɗi ma̱n ba̱n, ba̱ hwotkii ɗe nii ka̱n ka yilli gaa gwaka̱n suk ilgwe ka dla̱m wu so
na̱k ɗe Shishi ga̱ Nya a ba̱lkii ilgwe ka dla̱m ka̱li wu.”
Yek ma̱lgon tet ka̱ mbala̱n wulti ɗe, “Ma̱n lishti, hwi yilka gini ta̱s huulini ilgwe aba ga̱na̱n ma̱shi yek ta̱ zakini wu.”
Yek Yesu wulti ɗe, “Ba mbala̱n, wok za̱n ɗe ma̱n huulti ga̱ɓa ka̱ tlo gwaka̱n wo?”
Yek ta̱ wulti ɗe, “Pa̱n ɗem'ɗem ba̱k za̱n mbadl gwaka̱n ten mot wul wonti so, na̱k ɗe yek ka laki a mbala̱n mbi mbadl sowu.”
Yek ta̱ cinga̱lisi ga̱ɓa gon ɗe, “Ma̱n wul ang gon ka̱n, zhin mbunit i'e.
Yek ta̱ daamti ka̱ mbadl gwas ɗe, ‘Nhu gwe ba wut wul zhin wu njika̱n ka̱wi.’
“Yek ta̱ po wul ka̱ mbadl gwas ɗa̱ɗe, ‘Ilgwe ba pa̱li go, ba tatl nhu jin ka a kin kiɗi a wut mas wul zhin gini suk wul ji giɓi.
A paa a wul gaa gi ɗe, “Wul wonti nik ɗa gwe a ta̱lak gin wonti wu, shuk ilgon gwa, aka̱ ngusi kumti ta̱mti.”’
“Yek Nya wulti ɗe, ‘Ki wo ka̱dla̱n ka̱n, ka̱ gas nge ka̱n ka ma̱shi, ta ɓo yen ma̱lgwe a nguk ilga̱n ɗe ka̱ mwe gaa gwa wu.’”
Yek Yesu wuli ɗe, “Nu ka̱n ani mal ma̱jwe mwe wul gaa gwasa̱n ten dii atli ama mal Nya wo ba̱ ilgon nisi ɗa̱ sowu.”
Yek Yesu hwi ma̱n kopti jwas ɗe, “A ni kii ma hwiti, ba̱ ilga̱ nguki suk luka̱l gwe ka lak wu hwotkii so.
Kangwe ka da̱n wu manikii ilga̱ nguki sa? A ba̱ tli gwaka̱n manikii luka̱l sa?
Ɓo yena̱n yadli, ba̱sa ɓak zhin so a ba̱sa wotl so. A ba̱ nhu wutti ilga̱ nguki nisi ɗa̱ so, na̱k ɗe Nya ka̱ nisi ma ba̱lti ilga̱ nguki wu. Nya lamkii man kangwe ta lam yatl wu sa?
Wok nii ka̱ kii ɗe ilgwe hwotti wu a mba̱lit multi ɗe na̱m dani wo?
Kume ka̱a̱ mani pa̱lti nak mil wul gaa gwaka̱n nu sogo, yek laki yek ka̱a̱ na̱ma hwotti mbadl gwaka̱n ye?
“Ɓo yena̱n mbuni buzha ka̱ me kangwe asa̱ nal wu, ba̱sa pa̱l ilgon so, a ba̱sa pa̱li luka̱l gaa gwasa̱n so. Ama ko ta̱ Sulemanu guu na̱ nalti gwas mago ta̱ ɓo taɓa kinti gwas mbuni nu so.
Kii ɗe ba̱ za̱t mbadl gwaka̱n ten Nya nda̱l sowu, kume nu ka̱n Nya pa̱l buzha ka̱ me mbuni jwe ase go sa̱ ni ɗa ama ayo go asa̱ lak ka̱ wutu wu, a kii ka̱n ba̱ta ba̱lkii luka̱l gwe ka lak wu sa?
Ba̱k za̱n mbadl gwaka̱n ten ilga̱ nguki suk ilga̱ tle so, mas ba̱ hwotkii so.
Mbala̱n ga̱ dii atl mas ɗe ba̱sa̱ yis Nya sowu na̱ma ngot wul jwisi, ama kii wo Aba gwaka̱n yisi ɗe ka̱ lami ta̱ wul jwisi ni kii ɗa̱.
Dloka̱ma̱nkii ta̱k kama̱n Nya ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl gwaka̱n, Nya a ba̱lkii mas wul jwisi.
“Ko ɗe ba̱ka̱a̱ wonti sogo, ba̱ ɓanti cikii so, na̱k ɗe bal Aba gwaka̱n pa̱l hwol tuk ɗe ta̱ telkii ka̱ boo gwas wu.
Wula̱n wul jwaka̱n ka aka̱a̱ ba̱l wulpi ma̱jwe ba̱ ilgon nisi ɗa̱ sowu. Za̱n wul jwaka̱n to nya ka, ka̱lu gwe ba̱ a lil ka̱ sowu, lu gwe muka̱l a mukli so, aba̱ da̱kmbi a lili ka̱ so.
Lu gwe wul jwaka̱n ni go ka̱li ka̱n mbadl gwaka̱n ani pak.
“Da̱ma̱n na̱ ka̱n gaa, ta̱ wutu yenti lu gwaka̱n cili,
na̱k zhel jwe na̱ma ɓa̱tti ga̱ baboo gwasa̱n ta̱s pal tet ka̱lu motgaa hapti wu. Ta̱ pal wugo ata̱ ɓwesi dlabi asa̱ ɓuliti ninge.

Zhel ju a mbi hwa wul kume baboomi palli a ba̱sa ɓo nde yeba̱l sowu. A ni kii ma hwit gem ɗe, ta ndus bal luka̱l gwe ta̱ lak wu ka, ata̱ wulsi ɗe ta̱s da̱m atli ta̱s nguk wul, ata̱ kopsi gaa-gaa ata̱ ba̱lsi ilga̱ nguki.
Zhel jo ma̱n mbit hwa wul ka̱n kume baboomi pal ka̱ tlo gas wu, sogo ka̱ bultlwe ata̱ mbisi ten ɓa̱tti gwas wu.
Ama ta̱k yisi ɗe, kume baboo a yis tulti ga̱ muka̱l go, ta zakti asa̱ tet lubii asa̱ lilit wul ka̱ so.
Kii mago, da̱ma̱n na̱ ka̱n gaa, na̱k ɗe ami Yen ga̱ Mbala̱n ba palli gas gwe ba̱ka̱ ɓo zi tulti gi sowu.”
Yek Biturus wul Yesu ɗe, “Bagaa, cinga̱lti ga̱ɓa ga̱n go ten mi na̱ ngwe na̱n ma, ko ten mas mbala̱n?”

Yek Yesu wule, “Wok ɗe ma̱n pa̱lti wul gibboo ga̱ baboo gwas ɗe ma̱n gem, ma̱n zok mbadli suk ma̱n ɓotlka̱n go? Ti ka̱n baboomi a zakit yenti lubii gwasi, ata̱ ba̱l zheli jon ju ilga̱ nguki na̱k gwe sa̱ zit pa̱lti wu.
Zhel go ma̱n mbit zok wul ka̱n ɗe baboo gwas a pal tet ka̱lu gwe ta̱ li wu ata̱ mbit ten pa̱lti hwa wul nu wu.
A ni kii hwiti gem ɗe, ta palli zhel wu ɗe bagaa ga̱ wul jwasi mas.
Ama kume zhel wu wul ka̱ mbadl gwas ɗe, ‘Baboo gi pal ba̱le so,’ yek ta̱ njel ɓot ji zheli jon ju na̱ modli na̱ maani, yek ta̱ njel tlati suk ngukti yek gaa ɓa gillit ka,
baboo ga̱ zhel wu a palli gas gwe ba̱ta̱ yisi sowu. Baboomi a pa̱lit byas ɓoti ata̱ keshti ka ata̱ za̱t ndakce suk ma̱jwe ba̱ gem nisi ɗa̱ sowu.
“Zhel gwe yis ilgwe baboo gwas lami yek ba̱ta̱ zi ka̱ mbadl gwas ɗe ta̱s pa̱li sogo, sa pa̱lit byas ɓoti.

Ama ma̱lgwe ba̱ta̱ yis ilgwe baboo gwas lami sowu, yek ta̱ pa̱l wul ɓot go, njet ka̱n sa ɓoti. Mas ma̱lgwe sa̱ ba̱lti wul nal go, sa ngo wul nal malti. Ma̱lgwe sa̱ ba̱lti nal mani go, nu ka̱n sa ngwe malti.
“Wutu ka̱n a tuli ta laki mbala̱n ten dii atli, lamti gi wo ta̱ wuti tlo.
Baptisma gwe sa pa̱li wu ni ɗa̱, a mbadl gi tli wi i'e ta̱s pa̱li ni.
Ka̱ da̱ma̱n gwa we ta̱mti ga̱ mbadl ka̱n a tullikii ten dii atli a? Ko njaa, a ni kii ma hwiti ɗe, huulti tlo ji yilkeni suk yilkeni ka̱n a tulli.
Ndok ase, mbala̱n ɗe namtan ka̱ lubii a huul ɗe lop. Ɗe lop na̱ma nget ga̱ ɗe mekan, a ɗe mekan na̱ma nget ga̱ ɗe lop.

Tlo gwasa̱n a hwuli, aba na̱ma nget ga̱ yen, a yen na̱ma nget ga̱ aba. Ana na̱ma nget ga̱ yen gwas ga̱ ma̱dli, yeni mago ata̱ na̱ma nget ga̱ ana gwasi. Nkwe ga̱ ma̱dli na̱ma nget ga̱ kili ga̱ yen gwasi. A kili ga̱ yeni na̱ma nget ga̱ ana ga̱ kos gwasi.”
Yek Yesu po wul mbala̱n ɗa̱ɗe, “Kume ka̱a̱ yen nyaze tli tot wugo, aka̱a̱ wule ze a nda a zesi nda kuwa.
Kume ka̱ kum yeta̱l ɓalma hotti tet go, aka̱ wule wutu cin a tuli, a wutu cinmi tul kuwa.
Ki ma̱n pa̱lti riya, ka̱ man yisti kangwe a wul pi ten dii atli suk to nya ka̱wu, ama yisti wul gwe na̱ma pa̱t ningo yek kanki gaa.
“Yek laki a ba̱ka daamki ta̱k yisa̱n ilgwe mbun ɗe ta̱k pa̱li wu so ye?
Kume ma̱lgon mbet a dlaboo kisti ga̱ɓa wu, tloki ta̱k la̱ka̱n tlo gwa sukti ten tantu, kume ka̱ nge go, ta ta̱lak dlaboo mal ma̱n ndoka̱lti ga̱ɓa asa̱ telki ka̱lu gwe asa̱ le ma̱n pa̱lti byas wul wu.
A nikma hwiti ɗe, ka yil ɗa̱ka̱ lwisi ka̱ so se ka̱ ɓatl ilgwe sa̱ mboshik wu mas.”
Ka̱ multi jwisi ɗe Yesu nisi ma hwit ga̱ɓa wu, yek ma̱jon ɗe sa̱ ni ka̱li wu dla̱mi Yesu ma̱n Galili jwe Bilatus laki yek sa̱ tlosi asa̱ na̱ma mboshti mba̱la sogo mal ta̱s tak Nya wu.
Yek Yesu nda̱kisi ɗe, “Na̱k ɗe ma̱n Galili ju ma̱sh nugo, ka̱ da̱ma̱n gwa we sa̱ pa̱l byas wul man naa mbala̱n mas a Galili a?
Ko njaa, a ni kii ma hwiti ɗe kume ka̱ ci atl gaa sogo nu ka̱n ka ma̱shi mas jwaka̱n na̱k gwasa̱n wu.
Ko mbala̱n ɗe kutl cet wusupsi jwe tlal bii ndesi gaa a Siluwam yek sa̱ ma̱sh go sa̱ pa̱l byas wul man mas ma̱n Wurshelima?
Ko njaa, a ni kii ma hwiti, kume ka̱ ci atl gaa sogo nu ka̱n mas jwaka̱n ka ma̱shi na̱k gwasa̱n wu.”
Yek Yesu cinga̱lisi ga̱ɓa gon ɗe, “Ma̱lgon pa̱l zhin yandi inabi gwasi yek ta̱ ɓak tlindi tula̱n a giɓi, yek ta̱ li ka̱ zhimi ta̱s kotl yandi tula̱mi ama yek ba̱ta̱ mbi ilgon dani so.

Yek ta̱ wul ma̱lgwe zhimi nit ang wu ɗe, ‘Gin naa ɗe mekan ka̱ ɓal gee ɗe a na̱ma tulti ngot yandi a dani a ba̱ba mbi ilgon sowu. Yek laki ɗe ma̱ zak tlindi tula̱n ga̱n ka̱lu gwe ma ɓaka̱n yandi inabi ka̱li gwe? Wotl ka!’
Yek ma̱lgwe zhimi nit ang wu wule, ‘Bagaa, ɓo zaki ta̱ po pa̱l gin ɗe na̱m ɗa̱ paa. Ba hwokit atl ɗa̱ zhila ka a wutit taki.
Kume guli wu aka̱ zaki, kume guli sowu aka̱ laki a wotl ka.’”
Gas gon Yesu na̱ma hwit ga̱ɓa mbala̱n ka̱lu motgaa ga̱ gwasa̱n gas shukti gwasa̱n.
A kili gon ɗe ma̱zhe laki yek cwo tlet tli ka̱wu ni ka̱li, ta̱ ɓal ka̱ gin ɗe kutl cet wusupsi ata̱ ni kontami. A ba̱ta man takti gwas so ko njet.
Yesu yenti wugo yek ta̱ mbet tet malti yek ta̱ wulti ɗe, “Kili mbala̱n, ka̱ mbi ndokti ɗa̱ka̱ cwo gwa ka̱wi.”
Yek Yesu zi kilisi ang ten gaa, yek ninge tli gwas taki yek ta̱ ngusi ta̱sti ga̱ Nya.

Yek mbadl lili bali ga̱ lu motgaami ɗe Yesu ndok ma̱lgon gas shukti gwasa̱n wu. Yek ta̱ wul mbala̱n ɗe, “Cin ɗe mukka ka̱n sa̱ ba̱la̱nnii ka̱n mba̱t ga̱ Musa ɗe ta̱n pa̱la̱n wul jina̱n, tula̱n ka̱ multi jwisi ta̱s ndokkii ama ba̱ ɗe gas shukti ga̱na̱n so.”
Yek Yesu ballit ɗe, “Kii ma̱n pa̱lti riya, ka̱a̱ kul pa̱tl tla suk zhaki jwaka̱n aka̱ ta̱lasi ka̱lu gwe sa tla ze wu gas shukti sa?
Kili ga̱n ɗe ga̱s ga̱ Ibirahim gwe Sheɗan lakit cwo hal ta̱ ɓal ka̱ gin ɗe kutl cet wusupsi go mbun ɗe ta ndokti gas shukti sa?”
Ta̱ dla̱m nu wugo yek nsha ci mas ma̱n nget gwasi, yek naa mbala̱mi ngusi hwol tuki ɗe sa̱ yen wul cit ɓanti gwe Yesu na̱ma pa̱lti wu.
Yek Yesu wule, “Nii ka̱n kanti ga̱ Nya ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl ga̱ mbala̱n ni gwi, na̱ yek ba cinga̱li ye?
Kanti ga̱ Nya ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl wo, na̱k gwe mbukla ka̱n ni, gwe ma̱lgon ɓak ka̱ zhin gwasi yek nali yek da̱n ɗe bal tlindi, yek yatl pa̱l bii jwasa̱n ten mil ami.”
Yek Yesu po kum ga̱zi ɗa̱ɗe, “Na̱ yek ba cinga̱l Nya ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl ga̱ mbala̱n ye?
Kanti ga̱ Nya ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl wo, na̱k yiis ka̱n ni gwe a modli la̱ski njet ka̱ apti a to wu.”
Yek Yesu ɓa li a Wurshelima go yek ta̱ koɓi ɗa̱nka̱ kiɗi suk nak mil ba̱n ka ata̱ nisi ma hwit ga̱ɓa.
Yek ma̱lgon ngemti ɗe, “Bagaa, ma̱jwe Nya a kissi go njet ka?” Yek ta̱ wulsi ɗe,
“Dloka̱ma̱nkii ta̱k koɓi tuka̱ ngaɓi dlabii na̱k ɗe mbala̱n wonti a ngwe ta̱s koɓi tuka̱li ama ba̱sa mani sowu.

Kume baboomi tlinya yek ta̱ le dlabiimi ka̱wu, kaa dla̱l a deɓa̱l aka̱ ngusi ɓot dlabiimi aka̱ na̱ma ngemti gwas ɗe, ‘Bagaa, ɓulinii dlabiimi.’ “A paa ta̱ balli kii ɗe, ‘A yis kii so, aba̱ a yis lu gwe ka̱a̱ yil tet wu so.’
“A paa ka̱a̱ wulti ɗe, ‘Mi ɗe ma̱ nguk wul yek ma̱ tla sukki wu aka̱ dla̱m ga̱ɓa ɗa̱n ten tantu ba̱n ga̱na̱n ka.’
“A ta̱ po balli kii ɗe, ‘A yiskii so, a baa yis lu gwe ka̱ yil tet wu so. Tli ɗa̱ mala̱n ka kii ma̱n pa̱lti byas wul.’

“Kume ka̱a̱ yen ka̱ Ibirahim suk Ishaku suk Yakubu suk mas ma̱n dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya ka̱ dlo ga̱ ma̱jwe kan Nya ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl gwasa̱n wu, a kii wo yek sa̱ mbolkii go, ka̱li ka̱n ka kuli aka̱ as ang bi.
Mbala̱n a yil tet tucina suk tet tukaali suk tet ten ang shinti suk ang yali ga̱ mas dii atli, asa̱ da̱n ka̱lu motgaa hwol tuki suk ma̱jwe kan Nya ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl gwasa̱n wu.
Na̱ nu ka̱n ma̱jwe nde ba̱le wu a pal tukaali, ma̱jwe nde ka̱ kaali wu a pal cina.”
Yesu ni nugo yek ma̱n Paresi jon li tet malti, yek sa̱ wulti ɗe, “Zigaa ɗa̱ ka̱lu ga̱n ka, na̱k ɗe Hiridus guu na̱ma ngot gwa ta̱s tloki wu.”
Yek Yesu wulsi ɗe, “Lak wula̱n ma̱n byas mbadl wu ɗe, ‘Ase suk ayo wo ba yilli ma̱zhe ɗa̱ka̱ mbala̱n ka, a ba ndok mbala̱n pak. Tli wu ka̱n ba paki.’
Mas na̱ nu ngetli ka̱n ni ɗe ta ci cina na̱ la̱t ka̱lu gwe ba li wu, ase suk ayo suk tli wu, na̱k ɗe sa man tlot ma̱n dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya ka̱lu gon so se a Wurshelima wu.

“Kii ma̱n Wurshelima ɗe ka̱a̱ tlo ma̱n dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya yek ka̱ lak ma̱jwe sa̱ shinsi malkii na̱ ye wu, asa̱mi ɗe na̱mi ka̱n a lam mot gwaka̱n na̱k gwe a ana kol moo mil jwas ka̱ bibaku gwas wu, ama yek ka̱a̱ nge.
Yekgu sa̱ zakikii lubii gwaka̱n wi koni. A ni kii ma hwiti ɗe, kaa po yena̱n so se gas gwe ka̱a̱ wule, ‘Ma̱n mbit hwa wul ga̱ Nya ka̱ɗe ma̱lgwe na̱ma tulti ka̱ shin ga̱ Bagaa Nya wu.’”
Gas shukti ga̱ Ma̱n Yehuda, yek Yesu te ka̱ lubii ga̱ bali ga̱ ma̱n Paresi gon ta̱s nguk wul yek mbala̱n wutit gwel ta̱s yen ilgwe ta pa̱li wu.
Yek ma̱lgon ka̱wu na̱ ang na̱ asa̱n gwasi mas kiɗi ka, ta̱ li tet mal Yesu.
Yek Yesu ngem ma̱n yisti mba̱t ga̱ Musa suk ma̱n Paresi ɗe, “Mba̱t ga̱na̱n ba̱li ɗe ta̱ ndok mbala̱n gas shukti a?”
Yek ba̱sa̱ wule ilgon so. Yek Yesu ta̱n ma̱n cwoɓi yek ta̱ ndokti yek ta̱ wulti ɗe, “Zigaa ilgon gwa.”
Yek Yesu ngem mbala̱mi ɗe, “Kume yen sogo tla gwaka̱n nda ka̱ shu gas shukti go, ka yilla̱t ka ba̱le-ba̱le so ɗe gas shukti a?”
Yek ba̱sa̱ mbi ilga̱ dla̱mi so.
Na̱k Yesu yen ma̱jon ka̱ mbala̱n jwe sa̱ mbesi ta̱s nguk wul wu na̱ma botlti hwa lu da̱nti ga̱ kiɗi mbala̱n wu, yek ta̱ cinga̱lisi ga̱ɓa gon ɗe,
“Kume ma̱lgon mbek ka̱lu motgaa hapti wu, ba̱k lak da̱n ka̱lu da̱nti ga̱ kiɗi mbala̱n so, gon asa̱ mbe ma̱lgwe nal man ki wu.
Ma̱lgwe mbekii mas jwaka̱n wu tul wugo, ta wule, ‘Tlinya ka ta̱k ba̱l lu,’ nsha a ciki na̱k ɗe ka pal ka̱lu da̱nti gwe ba̱ nal na̱k gon wu sowu.

Ama kume sa̱ mbek ka̱lu motgaa wugo aka̱ ngo lu da̱nti ga̱ ma̱jwe ba̱sa̱ ni ten bi ilgon sowu. Kume ma̱lgwe mbek wu tul wugo ta̱ wulki ɗe, ‘Yela̱n gini, li te ta̱k da̱n a nde.’ A laki, a ma̱jwe ni ka̱li wu yen nalti gwa.
Mas ma̱lgwe nalli gaa gwas go mbala̱n a palla̱t ɗe ilgon so, ama ma̱lgwe palli gaa gwas ɗe ilgon sogo, mbala̱n a nalla̱ti.”

Yek Yesu wul ma̱lgwe mbet ka̱lu motgaami wu ɗe, “Kume ka̱ ɓa mbe mbala̱n ta̱s nguk wul a lubii ɗakka sogo ka̱lu motgaa hwol tuk wu, ba̱k mbe yela̱n jwa suk yilkeni jwa suk ma̱jwa suk yela̱n da̱nti jwa ma̱n wul ang so, na̱k ɗe gas gon wo sa mbek ka̱lu motgaa gwasa̱n pak asa̱ pa̱lik ilgwe ka̱ pa̱lisi wu.
Ama kume ka̱ ɓa mbe ma̱jon ka̱lu motgaa hwol tuki go, aka̱ mbe ma̱jwe ba̱ ilgon nisi ɗa sowu suk ma̱jwe man la̱t na̱ asa̱n sowu, suk ma̱jwe tli gwasa̱n tla ka̱wu suk dwa.
Na̱ nu ka̱n ka mbi hwa wul ga̱ Nya, na̱k ɗe si wo sa man ɓatlti gwa sowu. Nya ka ɓatlki gas gwe ma̱n pa̱lti zok wul a tlinya tot ka̱ gaa zukɗi gwasa̱n kaami wu.”
Yek ma̱lgon ɗe ta̱ ni suksi wu kumi nu wugo yek ta̱ wule, “Ma̱n mbit hwa wul ga̱ Nya ka̱ɗe ma̱lgwe a nguk wul ka̱ motgaa hwol tuki suk ma̱jwe kan Almasihu ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl gwasa̱n wu.”
Yek Yesu wulti ɗe, “Ma̱lgon ni ɗa, ta̱ mbe mbala̱n wonti ka̱lu bal motgaa ngukti wul gwe ta pa̱li wu.
Yek motgaami ɓalɗa̱ go yek ta̱ shin zhel gwasi ta̱s hwi ma̱jwe ta̱ mbesi ka̱lu motgaami wu ta̱s li te.
Yek mas jwasa̱n sa̱ ngusi dla̱mti iljwe a laki a ba̱sa mbi la̱t ka̱lu motgaami sowu. Yek gwe nda ga̱ɓa wu wule, ‘Aya wul lu zhin, a lam la̱t yenti.’ Yek ta̱ wule ta̱ ma̱li tlo mbadli.
Yek gon po wule, ‘Aya wul tla gut zhin ɗe kutl, ba ta̱lasi ta̱s nda gut zhin, lak wul ma̱li ɗe ta̱s tlo mbadli.’
Yek gon po wule, ‘Ka̱ multi jee ka̱n aya pa̱l pyal kili. Ba mbi la̱t so.’

Yek zheli lak hwi baboomi mas ilgwe sa̱ hwit wu. Yek mbadl ga̱ baboomi lil i'e yek ta̱ wul zheli ɗe, ‘Li ka̱ ba̱mi aka̱ ma̱tl ɗa̱nka aka̱ mbe ma̱jwe ba̱ ilgon nisi ɗa̱ sowu suk ma̱jwe man la̱t na̱ asa̱n sowu suk ma̱jwe tli gwasa̱n tla ka̱wu suk dwa.’
Yek ta̱ pal wugo, yek ta̱ wul baboomi ɗe, ‘Baboo, a pa̱l ilgwe ka̱ dla̱m wu yi, ama hal ninge naa lu yi.’
Yek baboomi wulti ɗe, ‘Kop tantu ta̱k li ka̱ nak mil ba̱n ta̱k mbe mbala̱n teɗi ta̱ lwisi njika̱n.’
A ni kii ma hwiti ɗe ma̱jwe sa̱ mbesi cina ka̱lu motgaami jo, gon a tul ɗe ta̱s la̱m ilga̱ nguki ga̱ motgaa hwol tuk gwe a pa̱li wu so.”
Mbala̱n wonti na̱ma kopti ga̱ Yesu yek ta̱ balla̱t malsi yek ta̱ wulsi ɗe,
“Mas ma̱lgwe lam kopti gini a ba̱ta̱ nge aba gwasi suk ana gwasi suk kili gwasi suk mil jwasi suk yilkeni modli suk maani, yek ta̱ nge gaa gwas pak sogo, ta man da̱nti ɗe ma̱n kopti gi so.
Mas ma̱lgwe kan bomti gwe ni ka̱ kopti gi sogo, ta̱ ɓo mbuk da̱nti ɗe ma̱n kopti gi so.
“Kume ka̱ lam kinti lubii ma̱n wulpi go, se ka̱ da̱mi yek ka̱ yen kangwe ka pa̱li wu suk wulpi gwe a kinik lubiimi wu, ko ilgwe nik ɗa̱ wu a kumik kinti lubiimi.
Kume ka̱ lak zhila biimi yek ba̱ka̱ man pakti kinti sogo, mbala̱n a gitliki.
Sa wule, ‘Ma̱lga̱n go ka̱dla̱n ka̱n, ta̱ nda kinti bii yek ba̱ta̱ man pakti so.’

“Sogo kume guu ga̱ ba̱n gon gwe ma̱n hapti dlo jwas wo zangu ɗe kutl wu a la dlanti suk guu ga̱ ba̱mi gon gwe ma̱n hapti dlo jwas wo zangu ɗe kutl ɗe lop wu. A ba̱ta da̱n ɗe ta̱s yeni ko ta mana̱n dlanti suk guu gwisi so so?
Kume ta mani sogo, ata̱ shin mil shinti mal guumi, ata̱ yi dlenti, ta̱s ngo ta̱mti da̱nti ka̱ dlo gwas sukti.
Nu ka̱n kume ka̱ zak mas wul jwaka̱n sogo, ka man da̱nti ɗe ma̱n kopti gi so.
“Kwi wo hwa wul ka̱n, ama lilka̱ wugo, na̱ yek a la̱kmi ye?
Mbala̱n a po pa̱l ilgon na̱ nali so na̱k ɗe ba̱sa wuti wo ka̱ zhin sowu. Wutti ka̱n sa wut ka. Ma̱lgwe ka̱n kumti niɗɗa̱ wu, ha̱n ta̱s kumi.”
Gas gon, ma̱n kanti wulpi boo suk ma̱jwe ba̱sa pa̱l hwa wul sowu tul mal Yesu wonti ta̱s kum ga̱ɓa gwasi.
Yek ma̱n Paresi suk ma̱n yisti mba̱t ga̱ Musa nda nala̱nti ɗe Yesu kan ma̱nda̱ki ga̱ ma̱jwe ba̱sa pa̱l hwa wul sowu ata̱ na̱ma ngukti wul suksi.
Yek Yesu hwisi ga̱ɓa gon ɗe,
“Wok ka̱ kii gwe ɗe mba̱la ɗe kutl ɗe kutl a nit ɗa a ɗe na̱m gil ka, a ba̱ta zak kutl ɗe topsi na̱ topsi ka̱lu ɗe na̱m ka̱ me ata̱ la ngot ga̱ ɗe na̱m wu se ta̱ mbit so wo?
Ta̱ mbit wugo ata̱ pa̱l hwol tuki ata̱ kanti a yal.
A ta̱ ta̱lat lubii apaa ta̱ mbe yela̱n jwasi suk yela̱n da̱nti ta̱s pa̱l hwol tuk sukti na̱k ɗe ta̱ mbi mba̱la gwas gwe gil ka̱wu.

A ni kii ma hwiti ɗe, nu ka̱n Nya suk mil shinti jwas a pa̱l hwol tuki nal na̱ ma̱n byas wul ɗe na̱m gwe ci atl gaa mal Nya wu man ma̱n pa̱lti zok wul ɗe kutl ɗe topsi na̱ topsi jwe a po ci atl gaa sowu.
“Sogo ta̱ wulpi ni kili mbala̱n gon ɗa azurfa ɗe kutl, yek ɗe na̱m gil ka. Ta ɓa̱s wutu ata̱ taas gibboomi ka ata̱ ngwe mas lu gwe ni wu se ta mbi.
Kume ta̱ mbi wugo, ta̱ mbe yela̱n jwasi suk yela̱n da̱nti ta̱s pa̱l hwol tuk sukti na̱k ɗe ta mbi wulpi gwas gwe gil ka̱wu.
A ni kii ma hwiti ɗe, nu ka̱n ani ɗe wul hwol tuk mal Nya suk mil shinti jwasi ɗe ma̱n byas wul ɗe na̱m ci atl gaa wu.”
Yek Yesu wule, “Ma̱lgon ni ɗa̱ ma̱n mil maani ɗe lop.
Yek ma̱ngaɓi wu wul aba gwasa̱n ɗe, ‘A lami ɗe ta̱k ba̱la̱n gi ka̱ ilgwe ka zaki ni kaal ɗa̱ ma̱shka̱n gwa wu ninge, ba ɓa̱ti ta̱k ma̱sh paa so.’ Yek abe huulisi wul jwasi.
“La̱m multi wugo yek yeni yem wul jwasi mas yek ta̱ zigaa ka̱ atl gon dlenti, yek ta̱ lil mas wul jwas ka ten byas da̱nti.
Yek wul jwas paki ka̱wu, yek bal kuza̱n gon te ka̱ ba̱mi, yek yeni te ka̱ bomti na̱k ɗe ilgon poyit sowu.
Yek ta̱ ngo ilga̱ pa̱li mal ma̱lgon ka̱ ba̱mi yek ma̱li ba̱lti kyo alade gwasi.
Yek ba̱sa̱ ba̱lti ilga̱ nguki so, yek ta̱ lami ɗe ta̱s nguk ilga̱ nguki ga̱ aladesi. Yek ba̱ta̱ mbi so.
“Yek ta̱ lak pal ka̱ hwa daamti gwas wugo yek ta̱ wul ka̱ mbadl gwas ɗe, ‘Zhel ji aba gi na̱ma ngukti asa̱ na̱ma tlati, a ilga̱ nguki nisi ɗa nal, ama ami wo amikgu ten tlat kuza̱n wule ba ma̱shinni.
Ba pal to mal aba gi ka aa wulti ɗe: Aba, a pa̱li Nya byas wul yek a pa̱lik pak.
A po mbuk da̱nti ɗe yen gwa so, kama̱n na̱k zhel gwa.’
“Yek ta̱ nda tantu ka̱li taɓa to mal aba gwasi. “Ama yek abe yisti tet dlenti yek gonti gwas citi yek ta̱ tlinya na̱ apti yek ta̱ ngipti te dlo ka yek ta̱ ngusi swatti gwasi.
“Yek yeni wulti ɗe, ‘Aba, a pa̱li byas wul Nya yek a pa̱lik pak, a po mbuki ta̱k mbe ɗe yen gwa so.’
“Yek abe wul zhel gwas ɗe, ‘La̱n na̱ apti ta̱k kama̱n luka̱l gwe mbun mani wu teɗi suk zobbe suk kapta̱lan.
Aka̱ dop tla gwe bas mani wu teɗi aka̱ mboshi ama̱ palla̱n hwol tuki.
Na̱k ɗe yen gi go ta̱ ma̱shi yek ningo ta pal wi, ta̱ gilka yek ningo a mbit wi.’ Yek sa̱ pa̱l hwol tuk i'e.
“A ba̱ ma̱nkolisi ni lubii so ata̱ ni ka̱ zhin, yek ta̱ pal wugo yek ta̱ ngusi kumti ɓot gan-gan suk wulti koo suk dlalti a lubii ɗaasika.
Yek ta̱ mbe zhel gon gwasa̱n ta̱s kum ga̱s ilgwe na̱ma pa̱t wu?
Yek zheli wulti ɗe, ‘Ma̱ngaɓi gwa ka̱ pal wi, yek aba gwaka̱n laki yek sa̱ mbosh tla gwe bas mani wu ta̱ mbala̱n pa̱l hwol tuk sukti na̱k ɗe yilka gwa pal boo ka̱ ta̱mti wu.’
“Yek mbadl lili ma̱nkolisi i'e yek ta̱ nge tet gibboo, yek abe yil tot gibboomi yek ta̱ ba̱lti bi ta̱s te gibboo.

Yek ta̱ wule abe ɗe, ‘Yek na̱k gwe? Mas da̱nti gwe a da̱n sukki wu, a nikma pa̱lti wul na̱k zhel, a mas ilgwe ka̱ lami go a pa̱liki, ama ko ga̱ cin ɗe na̱m ka̱ pa̱li ilgon nu so, a ba̱ka̱ ba̱la̱n ko ta̱ yen mal ɗe ta mboshi a mo mbala̱n ji so.
Ama yek yen gwa pal wi kaal ɗa̱ tlot wulpi gwa ka ten muka̱l modli, yek ka̱ mbe mbala̱n yek ka̱ mboshit tla gwe bas mani wu.’
“Yek abe wulti ɗe, ‘Yen gini, ka̱ ni suk ami ko gasi, mas wul ji wo jwaka̱n.
Mbun ɗe ta̱n pa̱l hwol tuki na̱k ɗe yilka gwa ma̱shi yek ta̱ tli ɗa̱ka̱ ma̱shka̱n ka wu, ta̱ gili yek ningo ta̱ pal boo wu.’”
Yek Yesu wul ma̱n kopti jwas ɗe, “Ma̱n wul gon ni ɗa gwe kan ma̱lgwe a pa̱lit wulbo gwas wu, ama yek ta̱ lak kumi ɗe ma̱li nitma lilti wul ka.
Yek baboomi mbet su gibboo ka, yek ta̱ wulti ɗe, ‘A kumi ɗe ka̱ nima lilti wul ka. Lak hwi kangwe ka̱ na̱ma pa̱lti wulbo gi wu ga̱ la̱shi, ka po da̱n ɗe ma̱n pa̱lti wul ga̱ boo gi so.’
“Yek ma̱li wul ka̱ mbadl gwas ɗe, ‘Baboo gi mbola̱n wugo, ba pa̱n nii? Na̱k ɗe ba̱ nda̱lti kolti zhin ka̱ niɗɗa̱ sowu, a nsha ngemti wul ka cin wu.’
Yek ta̱ po wule, ‘A yis ilgwe ba pa̱li ɗe ta̱ naa mbala̱n pa̱l ɗem na̱ ami a lubii ɗaasika wu wi.’
“Yek ta̱ mbe mas ma̱jwe baboo gwas na̱ma kopti gwasa̱n duul wu, yek ta̱ ngem ma̱lgwe la̱t tet cina wu ɗe, ‘Na̱mi kan baboo gi na̱ma kopti gwa?’
“Yek ta̱ wulti ɗe, ‘Ta̱ na̱ma kopti gi bunta̱n mili zamba̱l ɗe wusupsi.’ Yek ma̱li wulti ɗe, ‘Da̱m atli ta̱k lish zamba̱l ɗe wupsi.’
“Yek ta̱ po ngem gon ɗa̱ɗe, ‘A kii hwa, na̱mi kan ta̱ na̱ma kopti gwa?’ “Yek ta̱ wulti ɗe, ‘Bal ngura zamba̱l ɗe na̱m ga̱ alkama.’ “Yek ta̱ wulti ɗe, ‘Kan wul lishti ta̱k lish kutl ɗe wusupsi.’
“Yek baboomi kum ilgwe ma̱n pa̱lti wulbo gwas na̱ma pa̱lti wu wugo, yek ta̱ ta̱s byas ɓotlka̱n gwasi, na̱k ɗe mbala̱n ji ninge man pa̱t na̱ mbala̱n jwasa̱n ji se man ma̱jwe ni ka̱ cilti ga̱ Nya wu.”
Yek Yesu po wule, “A ni kii ma hwiti, pa̱la̱n wul na̱ wul ang gwaka̱n ta̱k mbi yela̱n ɗa. Na̱ nu ka̱n kume wul gwaka̱n paki wugo sa pikii ɗem ka̱ boo ga̱ Nya.
“Ma̱lgwe pa̱l gem ten ngipti nak'en wul go, ta man pa̱lti gem ten ngipti kakshe. Ma̱lgwe pa̱l gem ten nak'en wul sogo, ta mani ten kakshe so pak.
A kume ka̱ pa̱l gem ten ngipti wul ji dii atl sogo, wok ka ba̱lkii hwa wul ga̱ Nya wo?
A kume ka̱ pa̱l gem ten ngipti wul ji ma̱lgon sogo, wok ka ba̱lkii gwaka̱n wo?
“Mbala̱n a man da̱nti ɗe zhel ga̱ baboo ɗe lop so, a kume ta̱ pa̱li nu go, ta nge gon ata̱ lam gon, sogo a ta pa̱li hwa wul gon ata̱ mbul gon. Ka man da̱nti ɗe zhel ga̱ Nya suk zhel ga̱ wulpi so.”
Na̱k ɗe ma̱n Paresi wo ma̱n lamti wulpi ka̱n i'e wu, yek sa̱ kumi nu wugo yek sa̱ desit njwaa.
Yek ta̱ wulsi ɗe, “Kik ɗe ma̱n lamti ɗe ta̱ mbala̱n yenki ɗe ma̱n zok mbadli, ama Nya yis mbadl gwaka̱n. Ilgwe mbala̱n yeni ɗe hwaɓi go, yek ka̱n Nya a ngeti.”

Yek Yesu po wul ma̱n Paresisi ɗa̱ɗe, “Mba̱t ga̱ Musa suk lishti ji ma̱n dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya ka̱ ni ɗa, yek Yohana ma̱n baptisma tuli, ama na̱k sa̱ dla̱m ga̱ɓa ma̱n ta̱mti ten kangwe mbala̱n a kan Nya ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl gwasa̱n wu, yek mbala̱n na̱ma tlot gwasa̱n i'e ta̱s te giɓi.
Tlo nya suk dii atl a man pakti ama ko njet ka̱ mba̱t ga̱ Musa wo gon a paki so.
“A ma̱lgwe huul suk kili gwasi yek ta̱ kan zopsi kili go ta̱ na̱ma pa̱t pa̱la̱n, a ma̱lgwe kan kili gwe huul suk kos gwas go, sa̱ na̱ma pa̱t pa̱la̱n pak.”
Yek Yesu wule, “Ma̱lgon ni ɗa̱ ma̱n wul, ata̱ lak luka̱l ma̱n wulpi ata̱ nguk hwa ilga̱ nguki ko gasi.
A ma̱lgon ni ten bi dlaboo gwasi asa̱ mbet ɗe Liazaru ma̱lgwe tli gwas wo mas usu wu a ma̱n ngemti wul ka̱ɗe ti.
A Liazaru ɓa̱t ilga̱ nguki gwe a lok sut ten lu ngukti ga̱ ma̱n wul wu, a kaɗi la̱pti usu gwe nit ten tli wu.
“Ni nugo yek Liazaru lak ma̱shi yek mil shinti ji Nya sak kanti yek sa̱ ba̱lti hwa lu da̱nti ka̱ boo ga̱ Nya ka̱lu gwe Ibirahim ni wu. Yek ma̱n wul wu mago yek ta̱ lak ma̱shi yek sa̱ lepti.
Yek mbadl gwas li ka̱lu da̱nti ga̱ ma̱n ma̱shka̱n yek ta̱ da̱n ka̱ bomti, yek ta̱ yen Liazaru suk Ibirahim tet dlenti.

Yek ta̱ taki bi Ibirahim yek ta̱ wulti ɗe, ‘Aba Ibirahim, yen gonti gini, aka̱ shin Liazaru ta̱s lak yen ang gwas ka̱ ze ta̱s nak laki sut ten la̱ka ne ta kum nda̱ɗiti ka̱ bomti ka̱n ani i'e ka̱ wutu.’
“Yek Ibirahim wulti ɗe, ‘Yen mbala̱n, daamki ɗe ka̱ yi ten dii atl go, hwa wul nik ɗa̱ a Liazaru ni ka̱ bomti, ama ningo ta̱ ɓal ka̱ ta̱mti a mala̱nni a ki wo ka̱ ni ka̱lu bomti.
A ban na̱ nu mago, bal buu ni ka̱ tlo ga̱na̱n sukki kangwe mas ma̱lgwe ni tumalki wu a man la̱t tet ka̱lu gwe ma̱ ni wu so, aba̱ ma̱lgwe ni tumalni wu a man ɗakciti tumalki so.’
“Yek ma̱n wuli wulti ɗe, ‘Aba Ibirahim, a na̱ma ngemti gwa, ta̱k shin Liazaru ta̱s su lubii ɗa̱ aba gi ka.
Yilkeni ni ɗa ɗe namtan ta̱s suk hwisi ba̱s kop tantu gwe a koɓi wu asa̱ li tet ka̱lu bomti ga̱n so.’
“Yek Ibirahim wule, ‘Mba̱t ga̱ Musa suk lishti ga̱ ma̱n dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya nisi ɗa̱ ta̱s katisi ka̱n.’
“Yek ma̱n wuli wulti ɗe, ‘Nuk so Aba Ibirahim, kume ma̱lgon yil tot ka̱ hwu mbala̱n yek ta̱ li malsi go sa kumi asa̱ cit atl gaa.’
“Ama yek Ibirahim wulti ɗe, ‘Kume sa̱ kum ilgwe mba̱t ga̱ Musa suk lishti ji ma̱n dla̱mti ga̱ɓa ga̱ Nya nisi ma dla̱mti wu sogo, ko ta̱ ma̱lgon tlinya tot ka̱ gaa zukɗi kaami sa kumti so.’”
Yek Yesu wul ma̱n kopti jwas ɗe, “Wul jwe a lak mbala̱n ten pa̱lti byas wul go a tuli, ama ma̱lgwe wul jwisi a tul tumalti go ta da̱m ɗe wul cit gonti.
Ɗa̱ gwe ta̱ ma̱lgon lak ɗe na̱m ka̱ nak mil jee ta̱s pa̱l byas wul go, a maniti ta̱s ɓalit ye na̱kti hwoo a yal asa̱ lakti ka̱ bal ze.
Pa̱n ɗem'ɗem na̱ gaa gwaka̱n. “Kume yilka gwa pa̱lik byas wul wu, aka̱ matlti, a kume ta̱ ci atl gaa wu, aka̱ taasi ɗa̱ ten mbadl ka.
Kume ta̱ pa̱lik byas wul asa̱mi ɗe nitgi ten cin ɗe na̱m ata̱ na̱ma palti tet malki asa̱mi ɗe nitgi ata̱ na̱ma cit atl gaa wu, aka̱ taasi ɗa̱ ten mbadl ka.”
Yek mil shinti ji botlisi wul Bagaa ɗe, “Mba̱lini za̱t mbadl ten Nya dani.”
Yek ta̱ wulsi ɗe, “Kume za̱t mbadl ten Nya ni kii ɗa njet na̱k gwe daazi wu, ka man wulti ga̱ tlindi ga̱n ɗe, ‘Ndus ɗa̱ka̱ lu gee ka ta̱k sak dla̱l ka̱ bal ze,’ a ilgwe ka̱a̱ dla̱m wu pi.
“Kume zhel ni gon gwaka̱n ɗa a zheli nitma kolti zhin sogo kyo mba̱la, a na̱ palti ga̱ zheli tet ka̱ zhin, a ma̱li wulti ɗe, ‘Li te ta̱k da̱m na̱ zhila ta̱k nguk wul la?’
Ba̱ta wulti ɗe, ‘Lak pa̱li ilga̱ nguki aka̱ ɓa̱tti ta nguki aa tla ze apaa ka̱ po nguki aka̱ tla pak’ sa?
Ta pa̱l hwol tuk na̱ zheli na̱k ɗe ta̱ kop ga̱ɓa gwas wu?”

Yek Yesu po wulsi ɗa̱ɗe, “Kii mago nu ka̱n, kume ka̱ pa̱l mas ilgwe sa̱ hwikii ɗe ta̱k pa̱li wu, ka wule, ‘Mi wo zhel ka̱n jwe ba̱ma̱ ni ten bi ilgon sowu, mi wo ilgwe mbun ɗe ta̱n pa̱li wu ka̱n ma̱ na̱ma pa̱lti.’”
A Yesu ni ten tantu la̱t Wurshelima, yek ta̱ yil ka̱ tlo ga̱ Samariya suk Galili.
Yek ta̱ ɓa te ka̱ nak'en ba̱n gon nu go yek ma̱n cwo gita jon ka̱ju si ɗe kutl, yek sa̱ dla̱l te dlenti ka.
Yek sa̱ tak bi na̱ nda̱lti ɗe, “Yesu, ma̱n lishti, yen gonti ga̱na̱n.”
Yek ta̱ yensi wugo, yek ta̱ wulsi ɗe, “La̱n mal ma̱n Pa̱ris ta̱s yisi ɗe ka̱a̱ ndoki wi.” Sa̱ ɓal ten tantu la̱t go, yek sa̱ ndoki.
Yek ɗe na̱m ka̱si yeni ɗe ta̱ ndoki wugo, yek ta̱ pal tet mal Yesu, ata̱ na̱ma ta̱sti ga̱ Nya na̱ nda̱li yal.
Yek ta̱ lak ngus a cina ɗa̱ Yesu ka, yek ta̱ ngusa̱l gaa gwas atli, yek ta̱ pa̱l hwol tuk na̱ Yesu. A ti wo ma̱n Samariya ka̱n.
Yek Yesu wule, “A wule mbala̱n ɗe kutl ka̱ mbi ndokti nwa? Na̱ topsi jon ju ɓal ko?
Yek ba̱ ma̱lgon pal tet ɗe ta̱s ba̱l nalti Nya so se ma̱nda̱ki ga̱n ma?”
Yek Yesu wul ma̱li ɗe, “Tlinya ta̱k zigaa, za̱t mbadl ten Nya gwa ndokki wi.”
Gas gon, yek ma̱n Paresi ngem Yesu ɗe, “A gasi ka̱n ma yen tulti ga̱ Almasihu ɗe guu gwi?” Yek Yesu wulsi ɗe, “Gas gwe Almasihu a da̱n ɗe guu ka̱ mbadl ga̱ mbala̱n go mbala̱n a man yenti na̱ gwel so,
aba̱ mbala̱n a wule ‘Yek ɓal ga̱n’ sogo ‘Yek tekgu’ so, na̱k ɗe ka̱ tlo gwaka̱n ka̱n ni wu.”
Yek Yesu po wul ma̱n kopti jwas ɗa̱ɗe, “Gas gwe ka lam yenti palti sut gini Yen ga̱ Mbala̱n wu ni teɗi ama ba̱ka yeni so.
Mbala̱n a shelkii ɗe, ‘Tik tekgu,’ sogo ‘Tik gee,’ ama ba̱k koɓa̱n ga̱ɓa gwasa̱n so.
Gas palti sut gini Yen ga̱ Mbala̱n wo mbala̱n mas a yena̱nni na̱k gwe a nyaze ci bi a cilti yil tet ten ka̱t dii atl gon a li ten ka̱ti gon wu.
Ama na̱k jwisi a ɓo pi so se ami Yen ga̱ Mbala̱n tla bomti nal paa a mbala̱n ji se a nge pak.
“Na̱k gwe pi ka̱ gin ga̱ Nuhu wu nu ka̱n a pi ten gin gwe ba pal sut ten dii atl wu.

Mbala̱n a na̱ma ngukti, asa̱ na̱ma tlati, sa̱ na̱ma hapti modli asa̱ na̱ma hapti mil jwasa̱n ka. Na̱ nu ka̱n yek cin gwe Nuhu te ka̱ jirgi wu tuli, yek bal ze yil sut tu nya suk tot tu atli yek tlo mbala̱n ka mas.
“Nu ka̱n pi ka̱ gin ga̱ Lutu pak mbala̱n na̱ma ngukti suk tlati, asa̱ na̱ma wulti wul suk wulti ka, sa̱ na̱ma ɓakti zhin asa̱ na̱ma kinti bii.
Ama gas gwe Lutu zak ba̱n Sodom wu, yek wutu suk wutu na̱k ze ngusi shoti sut nya yek tlosi ka mas.
“Nu ka̱n ani ten gas gwe ami Yen ga̱ Mbala̱n a pal sut wu.
Ten cin gwisi wo, ma̱lgwe ni to ten tlal bii gwas ka̱go ba̱s yil sut ɗe ta yem wul jwas ɗa̱ gibboo ka̱ so. Nu ka̱n mas ma̱lgwe li ka̱ zhin wu ba̱s pal lubii so.
Ɓo daama̱nkii ten kili ga̱ Lutu.
Mas ma̱lgwe nge ten mbadl gwas go ta mbi so ama ma̱lgwe ba̱l mbadl gwas go za̱ti ka̱n ta̱ zit ka.
A ni kii ma hwiti ɗe, ten gas gwe na̱k gwisi a pi wu, mbala̱n ɗe lop ani ten lumulti ɗe na̱m, Nya a kan gon ata̱ zak gon.
